en.summary: RRSI leaves the harness edit space open while regularizing proposal and selection. It anneals the number of independent edits, conditions proposals on an evidence ledger and redirects stalled search toward untried components. A pre-evaluation critic screens leakage; admissibility combines a best-ever noise-adjusted floor, gain-dependent token-cost control, a separate within-noise-band rule and domain guards. Unproductive components become pruning targets.

en.summary: Task-level recursion performs contrastive Propose–Probe–Compose over executable harness edits. Invariant and domain-specific candidates are executed on the current task; their behavioral contrasts guide selective composition. After the task, an improvement library retains the adopted executable harness and supported lessons. Subsequent tasks restart from the common execution harness but use the updated library to guide refinement. Model weights, stage instructions and decision rules remain fixed.

A router uses the task and observable base execution to choose one complete specialized class or reuse the base result; ancestor classes are not separately executed agents.

scenes.title: 通用 RSI：独立晋级与回滚
scenes.object: 被允许修改的持久状态
scenes.fixed: 最终评价器、权限边界、资源上限
scenes.note: 本图是建议协议，不是任何单篇论文的实现；不合格候选被拒绝，不假设每轮进步。

steps.label: 观察旧版本
steps.detail: 保存状态、运行条件、任务分布与失败轨迹。建立可重复基线，区分缺数据、缺技能和控制故障。

steps.label: 提出候选
steps.detail: 在预注册的可变接口中提出修改。记录理由与预期影响；不能同时改评分规则以迎合新候选。

steps.label: 隔离执行
steps.detail: 按相同资源上限执行候选。保存成功、失败、超时和依赖信息，宿主限制候选的权限。

steps.label: 开发集选择
steps.detail: 使用允许暴露的开发信号排序候选。相同验证集被反复使用会产生适应偏差，不再称最终盲测。

steps.label: 独立晋级
steps.detail: 冻结候选，使用轮换晋级验证及最终盲测检查质量、风险、成本和迁移。失败则保留旧版本。

steps.label: 持久部署与回流
steps.detail: 只有通过验收的版本进入下轮。另测新系统是否真正参与下轮改进，以及改进效率是否改善。

scenes.title: STaR / ReST-EM：生成—筛选—学习
scenes.object: 生成模型、筛选轨迹与训练产物
scenes.fixed: 题目与答案/执行真值、论文规定的训练调度
scenes.note: 这是共同结构；STaR 的答案条件 rationalization 与 ReST-EM 的 E/M 调度不同。原始方法的基座重置不能省略。

steps.label: 准备外部真值
steps.detail: 保留问题、已知答案或测试。自生成的是轨迹，不能把已有监督说成凭空产生的真值。

steps.label: 当前模型采样
steps.detail: 固定本阶段策略，生成多个回答或程序。记录采样预算，更多采样本身可能改善结果。

steps.label: 筛选成功轨迹
steps.detail: 只保留通过答案/程序检查的样本。STaR 还可对失败题在答案条件下生成解释，再移除答案提示。

steps.label: 监督更新
steps.detail: 按各论文的参数初始化和训练调度学习筛选轨迹。正确答案不保证推理过程忠实，有限 SGD 不提供测试单调保证。

steps.label: 独立任务评价
steps.detail: 在未用于过滤的数据上检查质量和成本。对比相同总预算的单轮更多采样与多轮训练。

steps.label: 新模型再生成
steps.detail: 更新后的生成器参与下一轮数据生成。持久回流存在，但改进程序本身仍可完全固定。

scenes.title: Absolute Zero：可执行任务自博弈
scenes.fixed: 执行器、任务接口与人工定义的奖励
scenes.note: 无对应的人类训练数据集不等于无预训练、无人工设计或无外部约束。

steps.label: 提案任务
steps.detail: 在规定的程序任务空间生成可执行挑战。任务接口限定可探索的能力范围。

steps.label: 执行与可解性检查
steps.detail: 通过执行建立可核查信息，检查格式与有效性。执行器只能覆盖规格内性质。

steps.label: 生成求解轨迹
steps.detail: 策略求解经过筛选的任务。保留尝试、失败与输出，而不只记录拿到奖励的样本。

steps.label: 构造角色奖励
steps.detail: 根据任务有效性、难度和求解结果形成训练信号。奖励函数属于设计选择，不是开放世界真值。

steps.label: 策略学习
steps.detail: 更新提案/求解能力并测量任务分布。防止题目变容易、覆盖收缩或执行漏洞被利用。

steps.label: 生成下一轮挑战
steps.detail: 新策略改变后续任务与轨迹。再做外部分布评价，不能仅凭内生奖励上升宣布通用能力提升。

scenes.title: 技能路线：持久工具与经验整合
scenes.object: 技能、工具、检索与适用条件
scenes.fixed: 基础模型与工作流，可依据具体方法变化
scenes.note: 本图综合 Yunjue / Voyager 类结构；两者具体环境、课程和验证方式不同。工具不抛异常不是任务正确。

steps.label: 检索已有技能
steps.detail: 用任务条件检索可执行程序和经验。记录检索成本与误命中，不默认所有旧技能都可迁移。

steps.label: 组合执行
steps.detail: 组合已有工具完成任务，区分运行异常、功能错误与最终任务失败。

steps.label: 识别能力缺口
steps.detail: 只有真实缺口才触发新技能生成。不能把所有失败都归因于工具不够多。

steps.label: 生成并验证
steps.detail: 生成新技能，运行隔离测试与功能检查；标明依赖、来源、版本和适用条件。

steps.label: 去重合并入库
steps.detail: 聚类、合并、回归测试并版本化。删减冗余与失效技能，防止错误知识固化。

steps.label: 后续任务复用
steps.detail: 测未见任务与新环境迁移。如果新库也参与下一次技能获取，才进一步讨论改进回流。

scenes.title: HarnessPro：性能—成本前沿
scenes.object: 提示、技能、工具和控制结构
scenes.fixed: 初始生成测试、性能底线、骨干和最终官方测试
scenes.note: 生成测试只生成一次并固定；Pareto 三档代表没有单一全序赢家。搜索费用与部署费用分开。

steps.label: 建立初始轨迹
steps.detail: 在 coreset 和验证任务收集初始 Harness 轨迹；DPP 平衡难度与多样性。

steps.label: 冻结生成测试
steps.detail: 由任务和初始轨迹生成测试，仅一次；在该信号上记录初始性能底线。生成测试可能继承错误先验。

steps.label: 诊断并编辑候选
steps.detail: 多个角色分析错误、冗余和成本，提出不同质量—成本优先级的 Harness 修改。

steps.label: 同测试评价
steps.detail: 对新旧候选使用固定生成测试，测通过率与执行费用。低于性能底线的候选被筛除。

steps.label: 保留三档前沿
steps.detail: 去除被支配候选，再以归一化加权平方距离选择 lite、medium、heavy，适应不同预算。

steps.label: 回流与最终盲测
steps.detail: 代表候选进入下一 epoch；结束后冻结产物，使用官方测试验收。开发前沿上进步不保证留出不退化。

scenes.title: Dream-RSI：离线回放与在线发现
scenes.object: 探索策略代码与发现历史
scenes.fixed: 基础发现 Agent、评价器与执行接口
scenes.note: 回放仅支持已记录树与合法前缀；不是训练神经世界模型，也不能无偏评价任意未见动作。

steps.label: 在线发现
steps.detail: 探索策略编排固定发现 Agent，执行昂贵实验并保存发现历史树与成本。

steps.label: 构建回放世界
steps.detail: 将已发生的发现树变成确定性回放环境。prefix-only 约束防止策略偷看尚未揭示的历史。

steps.label: 提出探索策略
steps.detail: 开发候选策略代码，改变选择、预算分配和探索行为；基础 Agent 保持不变。

steps.label: 同历史离线评价
steps.detail: 在同一历史支持集比较质量—成本偏好和并行惩罚。当前策略作为候选只提供此历史内的保底。

steps.label: 冻结选中策略
steps.detail: 保留适当策略并记录离线评价。离线成本较低不表示策略提案或总发现成本为零。

steps.label: 返回在线扩展
steps.detail: 部署策略并产生新发现历史，进入下一轮。单独检验离线排名与在线收益的对应及支持集外失效。

scenes.title: MetaRSI：三算子、双轴与调度
scenes.object: 数据、Harness、训练产物、算子提案与调度策略
scenes.fixed: 受保护执行/评价内核与最外层 meta-policy
scenes.note: 这是论文结构示意；开放科学是议程，实验主要在代码与闭式科学。三算子不是本图谱的三个递归等级。

steps.label: 观察诊断
steps.detail: 统一内核收集当前系统失败和证据。目标模型承担多个角色，不消除同模型的共享错误。

steps.label: 水平选顺序
steps.detail: 选择 Data-RSI、Harness-RSI、Model-RSI 的有类型组合；需要当前版本新鲜证据。

steps.label: 垂直改提案
steps.detail: 优化各算子的提案策略。Harness 不改权重；Model 候选按论文规定从基座和累计数据训练。

steps.label: 执行与选择
steps.detail: 受保护代码验证边界、执行、选择与导出。候选生成权不等于发布权。

steps.label: 按 term 改调度
steps.detail: 依据完整 term 结果更新路由、预算、停止和垂直优化时机。最外层机制仍冻结，递归层数有限。

steps.label: 配对继续验证
steps.detail: 从同一个系统分叉，比较旧/新改进器同预算的后续收益；另核对跨 term 留出访问依赖。

scenes.title: CoEvo-RSI：模型—Harness 双向继承
scenes.object: 模型 checkpoint、Harness 与轨迹数据
scenes.fixed: 任务评价及预先约定的实验预算
scenes.note: 依据原摘要与已有专题证据的结构示意；共演化不自动证明不断加速。

steps.label: 读取共同档案
steps.detail: meta-agent 读取历史框架、模型 checkpoint 和执行反馈，保留成败谱系。

steps.label: 继承框架设计
steps.detail: 利用旧设计提出当前 Harness，避免单一路线从头搜索或过早锁定。

steps.label: 选择/合并模型
steps.detail: 从历史 checkpoint 选择或合并可用能力，而不是每次假定最新模型最合适。

steps.label: 框架下轨迹适配
steps.detail: 在选定 Harness 下收集拒绝采样的自身轨迹，使用 SFT 对齐执行要求。

steps.label: 测脑—身体匹配
steps.detail: 做旧/新模型与旧/新 Harness 的交叉评价；固定搜索、训练、执行资源，隔离联合收益。

steps.label: 双向历史回流
steps.detail: 合格组合进入档案，为下一轮提供框架和模型继承。跟踪泛化和改进成本，而非只看当前垂直应用分数。

scenes.title: 评价器：校准、冻结与独立审计
scenes.object: 候选评价器、反馈规则与校准资产
scenes.fixed: 独立审计集、最终报告集、发布权限与规格
scenes.note: 这是 E 家族建议协议，不是某篇论文共同实现；评价器自评分提升不是正确性的证明。

steps.label: 记录反馈失效
steps.detail: 记录奖励投机、裁判分歧、测试遗漏与真实任务失败。区分评分器错误、规格缺失和求解器错误。

steps.label: 建立校准资产
steps.detail: 用独立来源、可执行真值或人工审定样本建立校准任务，明确评价器适用范围与不确定性。

steps.label: 提出评价器更新
steps.detail: 在允许接口中更新裁判、测试或奖励模型。保留版本与来源，被测系统不能修改最终报告规则。

steps.label: 独立校准检查
steps.detail: 测试可靠性、误差、对抗鲁棒性和新分布表现。与旧评价器比较，并报告假阳性和假阴性。

steps.label: 冻结并授权发布
steps.detail: 外部准入流程决定是否部署。拒绝候选时继续使用旧版，不能通过候选自评分宣布晋级。

steps.label: 后继链再审计
steps.detail: 新评价器进入允许的开发闭环，但最终报告集保持隔离。跨代重复访问和评价器漂移需要持续检查。

scenes.title: RSI-Opt：跨运行政策与训练内适应
scenes.fixed: LLM、meta-agent 指令、任务划分、评价规则与决策机会数量
scenes.note: 固定 meta-agent 修改 optimizer-agent 的策略，不是 meta-agent 自修改。合法低分候选也入档；历史留出暴露与成本仍需审计。

steps.label: 选择父代政策
steps.detail: 在已评价档案中采样父代，偏好高分但抑制重复扩展同一分支。

steps.label: 修改跨运行资产
steps.detail: 固定 meta-agent 依据运行摘要更新提示、经验手册、优化器代码库和决策时机；可做 CPU proxy 实验。

steps.label: 验证候选结构
steps.detail: 检查模板字段、Python 语法和大小；无效候选进入有上限的修复流程。格式通过不是功能收益证明。

steps.label: 训练内优化适应
steps.detail: 内层 Agent 看损失/诊断，编辑工作区更新器并短窗口试跑。架构、数据和更新次数固定；最终指标 withheld。

steps.label: 外层评价与归档
steps.detail: 外层读取最终指标，按同任务/种子评分；所有合法候选入档，包括低于父代者。标准化分数不是显著性检验。

steps.label: 政策继承与迁移
steps.detail: 下一代继承经验和工具，另测留出任务与跨模型转移；匹配预算的独立提案对照仍是重要缺口。

family_architectures.title: 模型与训练
family_architectures.idea: 把可用反馈转成跨轮保留的模型能力；关键是参数或训练配方真的变化，而不是本次答案被修改。
family_architectures.persistent: 模型权重 θ、adapter、训练配置和训练数据版本
family_architectures.boundary: 题目/数据来源、验证口径与预算要声明；教师或答案监督不能被隐藏。
family_architectures.distinction: 自训练、自博弈、RL、蒸馏和测试时适应是不同子路线；每轮初始化与参数继承方式按具体论文核验。
family_architectures.evidence: 检查真实更新、数据回流、固定任务评价与遗忘；参数变化不自动证明泛化收益。

ui_translations.scope: English editorial summaries of the frozen public draft, not new source verification or independent replication. Original method-specific limitations and reading scopes remain available with an explicit original-language label.

A.name: Models & training
A.idea: Turn feedback into retained model capability. Verify actual parameter or recipe changes, supervision, initialization, forgetting and held-out transfer; a revised answer is not a new model.

B.name: Data, tasks & environments
B.state: Curricula, task generators and replay worlds
B.idea: Improve the learning distribution itself while preserving validity, solvability and coverage. More or harder tasks do not by themselves establish capability growth or external transfer.

C.name: Agent memory & skills
C.state: Experience, skill libraries and reusable programs
C.idea: Convert execution experience into retrievable, composable assets. Check semantic correctness, versioning, applicability and negative transfer; some A+C methods also train parameters.

D.name: Harnesses & workflows
D.state: Prompts, tools, routing and control code
D.idea: Optimize execution structures around the model using trace diagnosis and versioned candidates. Separate search from deployment cost; a fixed outer optimizer is not automatically meta-recursion.

E.name: Evaluators & verification
E.state: Feedback, reward models, tests and promotion rules
E.idea: Improve the feedback process while keeping independent calibration and final reporting protected. A judge's higher self-score is not evidence that its judgments became correct.

F.name: AI research & meta-improvement
F.state: Research strategies, improvement operators and search
F.idea: Make research or improvement procedures the object of change. Test successors through matched-budget continuations; a better task score does not establish a better improver.

arxiv:cs/0309048.summary: A theoretical foundation for provably justified self-modification. Theoretical optimality is not experimental evidence for modern agents.

arxiv:1712.01815.summary: A foundational reference for self-play training, not direct evidence that a system autonomously rewrites its improvement procedure.

arxiv:1901.01753.summary: Environment–policy pairs co-evolve through environment mutation, admission criteria, novelty selection, optimization and policy transfer. Bounded encodings and fixed morphology limit claims of open-endedness.

arxiv:2006.08381.summary: Program-library accumulation and learned search reinforce one another. This is an early reference for persistent reusable knowledge, not proof of unbounded recursive acceleration.

arxiv:2012.02096.summary: A representative route for unsupervised environment design and curriculum generation. Treat environment adaptation separately from self-modification of the improver.

arxiv:2203.14465.summary: Generate reasoning, filter using supplied answers, rationalize failures with answer hints, remove those hints and fine-tune anew from the original base each round. Correct answers do not ensure faithful reasoning.

arxiv:2212.08073.summary: A foundation for alignment training with AI feedback and explicit principles. Human-defined supervision and constraints remain part of the system.

arxiv:2212.10560.summary: A language model expands human-seeded instructions and examples, filters invalid or near-duplicate instances, then instruction-tunes the original model. Synthetic expansion is not supervision from nothing.

arxiv:2303.11366.summary: Convert task feedback into verbal reflections retained in episodic memory for later attempts, without weight updates. Memory reuse does not establish evolution of the update rule.

arxiv:2303.17651.summary: Iteratively revise an answer using feedback. Included as an output-refinement boundary case, not as evidence of persistent cross-task self-improvement.

arxiv:2305.16291.summary: An automatic curriculum, executable skill library, environment feedback and error-driven prompting support Minecraft exploration. The system uses black-box GPT-4 calls rather than parameter fine-tuning.

arxiv:2308.08998.summary: A representative generate–filter–retrain loop. Persistent training updates should be distinguished from changes to the improvement procedure itself.

arxiv:2309.16797.summary: Co-evolve task prompts and mutation prompts. The retained prompt assets and the boundaries of the outer evolutionary process require separate inspection.

arxiv:2310.02304.summary: A fixed language model drives a seed improver that generates and selects programs, then treats the improver itself as the target program. The abstract supports this structure, not an unrestricted acceleration claim.

arxiv:2310.03714.summary: Represent text transformations as declarative modules and compile their composition against a supplied metric using examples, prompting or fine-tuning. The metric and compiler remain explicit design choices.

arxiv:2312.06585.summary: Sample solutions to external training prompts, retain outputs passing binary feedback, reset to the base model and fine-tune before resampling. Preserve the paper's reset and E/M schedule.

arxiv:2401.01335.summary: Contrast fixed supervised targets with responses from the previous policy using a log-ratio logistic objective. The updated policy becomes the next opponent and reference; external targets remain.

arxiv:2401.10020.summary: The instruction model also judges candidate answers; self-scored preference pairs train the next model with iterative DPO. Seed data initialize both roles, and shared judgment errors remain possible.

arxiv:2406.07496.summary: Propagate language-model feedback through a computation graph to revise prompts, code and other variables. Textual gradients are not numerical differentiation of neural weights.

arxiv:2408.08435.summary: A fixed meta-agent reads an archive, generates agent forward code, reflects, evaluates and records candidates. Bounded error repair and a fixed meta-agent limit self-modification claims.

arxiv:2410.10762.summary: Search over complete code workflows with an MCTS variant, mixed parent sampling, language-model edits and repeated execution feedback. The model, formatting and search procedure remain fixed.

arxiv:2502.05171.summary: Repeat a recurrent block at inference time to increase latent computation depth. This does not establish persistent cross-task updates or improver evolution; its first release is outside the current annual window.

arxiv:2504.15228.summary: An agent modifies its own coding implementation. Direct code self-editing should not be equated with demonstrated improvement of the successor's improvement efficiency.

arxiv:2504.16084.summary: A representative route for test-time parameter adaptation. Distinguish weight changes from external memory, harness edits and changes to the adaptation rule.

arxiv:2505.03335.summary: One model proposes and solves deduction, abduction and induction tasks grounded in deterministic Python execution. Learnability and correctness rewards remain human-designed constraints, not open-world ground truth.

arxiv:2505.22954.summary: Archived parents implement their own code changes while a fixed diagnostic module supplies improvement tasks. Compilable successors retaining editing capability may enter the archive even without immediate gains.

arxiv:2506.10943.summary: Learn to generate adaptation data and update instructions for model self-adaptation. The inner parameter update and outer learning loop must be distinguished from arbitrary model training.

arxiv:2506.13131.summary: Human-specified mutable program blocks and evaluators guide an evolutionary database; model-generated diffs pass evaluation cascades. A separate meta-prompt database can evolve mutation instructions.

arxiv:2507.19457.summary: Reflect on reasoning and tool traces to propose prompt edits and combine complementary candidate experience. The draft's abstract-level evidence does not justify redefining its frontier as performance–cost or asserting equal-budget rankings.

arxiv:2510.04871.summary: A small network recursively refines internal state within a single problem. Internal recursive computation is not persistent cross-task RSI; the October 2025 first release is outside the annual window.

arxiv:2511.10395.summary: Self-questioning generates tasks, self-navigation reuses experience and self-attribution assigns rewards. The abstract describes preliminary evidence; less manual task construction does not eliminate environment feedback.

arxiv:2511.13646.summary: Starting from a minimal bash scaffold, the agent edits that scaffold while solving software tasks. The abstract supports runtime self-modification, not verified cross-task inheritance or stronger successor improvers.

arxiv:2511.16043.summary: Related curriculum and execution agents co-evolve over multiple steps, with tools extending solutions and enabling harder tasks. Zero external data does not mean zero priors, tools or verification assumptions.

arxiv:2512.05145.summary: Synthesize multimodal answers at intended quality levels, filter judgments and reasoning, then train a judge. Avoiding human preference labels does not turn self-assigned quality levels into independent truth.

arxiv:2512.17102.summary: Sequential rollouts inherit a skill library across related tasks and reward skill consolidation. Main reported results depend on expert-experience SFT initialization, not supervision-free general evolution.

arxiv:2601.03192.summary: With the reasoning model fixed, learn episodic-memory utility from environment feedback and retrieve in two stages. Runtime memory learning is not a model-weight update or proof of a self-evolving retrieval rule.

arxiv:2601.18226.summary: A fixed workflow retrieves, develops and executes tools, then aggregates and merges them into a persistent library. Model weights stay fixed; this is a memory/skills route at the persistence–feedback boundary, not a self-rewriting meta-algorithm.

arxiv:2602.02474.summary: A controller selects memory skills, an executor writes memory and a designer revises skills from difficult cases. Memory operations become mutable, but stronger designer improvement rules need a separate test.

arxiv:2603.06333.summary: Combine weighted semantic, lexical, structural and distribution drift with constraints and regression risk to stop refinement. Appendices describe quality/drift feedback for the next improvement prompt; this does not guarantee useful recursion.

arxiv:2603.08640.summary: A CLI research agent chooses data and training recipes for a supplied base model under benchmark and resource constraints, submits a checkpoint and is audited for contamination or model substitution. This is an evaluation setting, not a new RSI algorithm.

arxiv:2603.19461.summary: The abstract places a task agent and self-modifiable meta-agent in one editable program, aiming to relax DGM's alignment assumption between coding and self-editing ability. It is not independent proof of recursive acceleration.

arxiv:2604.00830.summary: An inner loop evaluates candidate update strategies using cross-episode experience; reflective outer meta-training uses balanced improvement scores. A learned updater is stronger meta-improvement evidence, not proof that the outer trainer accelerates recursively.

arxiv:2604.09297.summary: Edit task-specific skill bundles and select with NSGA-II over pass rate and cost. The solver, optimizer and short population schedule are fixed; this is persistent asset optimization, not demonstrated improver evolution.

arxiv:2604.17091.summary: With fixed model weights and nine atomic tool interfaces, distill verified execution experience into facts, SOPs and reusable scripts retrieved in layers. Skill-tree exploration does not by itself prove meta-recursion.

arxiv:2604.20987.summary: Co-train a decision agent and skill-bank agents using trajectory segmentation, effect contracts and curator checks for skill creation and maintenance. Five functional LoRAs use GRPO; this is not a fixed-weight memory-only method.

arxiv:2604.25850.summary: Use file-level components, hierarchical trace reports and change manifests in a rollout–attribute–rollback–distill–edit–commit cycle. The base model and validation infrastructure stay fixed; the outer optimizer is not self-evolving.

arxiv:2605.06130.summary: One trainable policy queries, reranks, executes and distills skills with a frozen retrieval encoder. Terminal reward, skill-utility EMA and relative distillation reward supervise different roles; proxy rewards require separate scrutiny.

arxiv:2605.08703.summary: Evolve tools and skills for image-editing reward judgments using preference examples, then supply rewards to downstream RL. A parameter-free reward harness is not human-preference-free, and rewarder gains differ from student gains.

arxiv:2606.01770.summary: Separate a persistent evolution workspace from the deployable harness, revising the evolution process and accumulated knowledge across a task stream. Archive growth is not guaranteed progress, and useful experience can become stale.

arxiv:2606.05922.summary: Select diverse tasks, collect grouped rollouts and propose harness candidates using self-validation and self-consistency. Update only on positive relative self-preference; the main experiment is a single-round persistent adaptation, not meta-recursion.

arxiv:2607.07663.summary: A survey organizes work by improvement object and loop structure, highlighting feedback, shared errors and research-direction selection. Its verification hierarchy is analysis, not a new algorithm or measured universal law.

arxiv:2607.25886.summary: A benchmark fixes the base model, LoRA SFT and evaluation infrastructure while researchers revise data strategies, select checkpoints from development feedback and undergo official evaluation. Data-policy search is distinct from model self-modification.

arxiv:2607.28568.summary: Executable ML-engineering environments train Draft, Improve, Debug and Crossover operators with SFT/RL; the operators are reused in experience-guided evolutionary search. Training-state selection differs from inference parent selection.

arxiv:2608.31111.summary: A vague-goal benchmark separates the updated model, harness, decision model and controller-only evaluator. Candidates face provenance checks, protocol-specific selection and weight rollback; this is an evaluation protocol, not unrestricted autonomy.

arxiv:2608.31100.summary: Separate self-testing, self-judging, consolidation and update from stricter held-out evaluation. Exploration sees self-scores, not verifier or terminal rewards; history, summaries and auxiliary parameter training are distinct persistence paths.

arxiv:2609.01437.summary: A creator builds a persistent executable harness, then frozen versions are evaluated with self or fixed executors. Evolution feedback and post-freeze held-out testing must remain distinct.

arxiv:2609.04280.summary: A benchmark supplies an expanding tool/skill/expert pool and separates outer harness evolution from inner state adaptation, measuring retention, adaptation and cost. Externally supplied growth is not agent-created capability or improver evolution.

arxiv:2609.06396.summary: Data, Harness and Model operators run on a protected kernel; scheduling order, proposal strategies and term-level routing are optimized. The outer meta-policy remains fixed, and Model candidates retrain from a fixed base; reported gains are not independent replication.

arxiv:2609.11873.summary: An autonomy roadmap distinguishes structural mechanism changes from effective recursion measured by stronger successors at matched budgets. Its normalized headroom-closure measure and levels are an analytical framework, not certification.

arxiv:2609.14858.summary: Turn completed discovery trees into prefix-observable replay worlds, compare rewritten exploration policies on archived histories and redeploy the best replay scorer online. Fixed agents and evaluators remain; replay cannot unbiasedly assess arbitrary unseen actions.

arxiv:2609.15364.summary: Curriculum, action and verification agents explore an environment, retain action-condition/consequence knowledge and freeze memory for downstream use. In-environment memory benefits are not the same as cross-environment generalization or parameter training.

arxiv:2609.20519.summary: An isolated offline research lineage selects four execution/information-flow mechanisms with capability and efficiency gates. The released runtime is a fixed persistent harness; multigeneration self-acceleration remains a future vision.

arxiv:2609.22086.summary: Expand and revise external procedural skills from design-task traces using matched replay gates to repair failures while retaining successes. Models stay fixed, and automatic scoring without reliable programmatic truth can bias selection.

arxiv:2609.24972.summary: With a fixed backbone and proposal/critic protocol, search harness edits using annealed edit budgets, attribution, guards, cost acceptance and pruning. This is a persistence/feedback boundary case, not L3 or parameter-norm training.

arxiv:2609.26457.summary: Propose and test research-agent source changes, then use accepted successors as the next editing target. Product-transfer gains do not isolate stronger improvers; the draft records unresolved ignition-control evidence.

arxiv:2609.30652.summary: Score student prefixes with a stop-gradient copy of the current checkpoint given privileged reference solutions; refresh both roles per update. Concise self-rewrite learning uses valid, correct, naturally terminated outputs generated without that reference; privileged supervision remains explicit.

arxiv:2609.33180.summary: Use decision-only feedback and a shared error budget over promotion histories, rounds and candidates, with paired tests and private cumulative-gain certificates. Statistical guarantees depend on the protocol's information restrictions.

arxiv:2609.36054.summary: Analyze feedback scenarios in which AI R&D automation compresses progress timelines and creates governance challenges. This is scenario analysis, not a new executable RSI method.

arxiv:2609.35561.summary: An Experiment OS constrains model-development actions and links experiment records; a separate Worker/Reviewer research DAG grows through evidence-guided orchestration. Workflow growth alone is not proof of recursive acceleration.

arxiv:2610.12176.summary: One model proposes, executes and evaluates multi-agent workflows, then fine-tunes shared weights on selected traces and restarts search. Shared-model supervision retains common blind spots, and training target tokens are not end-to-end cost.

arxiv:2610.14224.summary: Propose–Probe–Compose searches invariant and domain-specific harness changes from a common task seed, retaining executable harnesses and evidence-backed improvement experience. This supports feedback reuse, while fixed phase rules limit claims about L3.

arxiv:2610.18083.summary: Persistent research agents use task-conditioned orientations and leader-mediated memory with sources and applicability; campaign review versions orientations, knowledge and skills for later campaigns without backbone updates. Memory inheritance is not sufficient evidence of a stronger improver.

arxiv:2610.20431.summary: Cross-agent experimental evidence revises hypotheses and implementations, then recombines retained hypotheses and complementary components. Transferred experience does not isolate a recursive gain in the collective improver.

arxiv:2610.22740.summary: A learned Director constructs graphs executed by frozen Workers. Skill-hidden learnability and randomized visible/hidden groups guide skill withdrawal and failure-to-skill revision while policies train; distinguish learned orchestration from unrestricted self-modification.

arxiv:2610.25078.summary: A fixed-parameter meta-agent selects historical harness bases and separately selects or TIES-merges checkpoints; verifier-approved trajectories support SFT, followed by validation-gated promotion. Co-evolution does not establish continuing acceleration.

arxiv:2610.26770.summary: Analyzer, Planner, Editor and TestSynth roles edit harnesses against once-generated fixed tests; a performance floor and Pareto filtering select up to three representatives. The improvement framework is fixed, and generated development tests differ from official testing.

arxiv:2610.32026.summary: A fixed meta-agent evolves an optimizer-agent's prompts, playbook, code and decision cadence from run evidence. Within-training edits use fixed decision opportunities; all valid candidates, including weaker ones, enter the archive. This is not meta-agent self-editing.

arxiv:2610.32253.summary: Recipes compose lifecycle operators and declare mutable resources; the framework checks real diffs, commits candidates and evaluates clean checkouts with bound identities. The gate determines parent eligibility, not guaranteed improvement.

arxiv:2610.34386.summary: Revise a multidomain data pool and written principles from proxy traces, choose a historical checkpoint and bounded LoRA settings, then evaluate on unexposed generalization suites. Proxy selection and final evaluation are distinct.

arxiv:2610.35193.summary: Audit updates, successor inheritance and improver changes through improvement validity, constraint preservation and effective oversight. Require matched paired continuations and independent reporting; this is an evidence framework, not a performance result.

arxiv:2611.03698.summary: Convert research artifacts and InspectAI tasks into executable post-training environments, filter reliability/discriminability, collect guided frontier-model traces and filter before researcher-model SFT. Retain the distinction between environment construction and demonstrated recursive improvement.

arxiv:2611.01113.summary: With reader and weights fixed, evolve at most five conditional principles using bounded candidates, staged registration and optional counterfactual gates. Post-hoc rule compilation and counterexample search are separate audits, not evidence of parameter learning.

arxiv:2611.03178.summary: A Main agent decides, a Coordinator retains runtime state and Subagents execute local work. Fixed GLM control/teaching supports failure diagnosis, data revision, trace filtering and Qwen SFT; preserve these asymmetric roles and supervision.

arxiv:2611.02797.summary: With the backbone fixed, evolve prompts, memory and harnesses on held-in task streams, then freeze state for replay and progressively broader generalization tests. Candidate feedback on held-in tasks is not final held-out evidence.

gate.title: General RSI · independent promotion & rollback
gate.fixed: Final evaluator, permissions and resource limits
gate.note: An authored recommended protocol, not an implementation shared by all papers. Reject unsuitable candidates; progress is not assumed.

steps.label: Observe the baseline
steps.detail: Save state, operating conditions, task distribution and failure traces. Establish a repeatable baseline and distinguish missing data, missing skills and control faults.

steps.label: Propose a candidate
steps.detail: Propose edits only through declared mutable interfaces. Record reasons and expected effects; do not change scoring rules to favor the new candidate.

steps.label: Execute in isolation
steps.detail: Run candidates under equal resource limits. Retain successes, failures, timeouts and dependencies; the host constrains candidate permissions.

steps.label: Select on development
steps.detail: Rank using permitted development signals. Repeated reuse of one validation set induces adaptation bias; that set is no longer a final blind test.

steps.label: Promote independently
steps.detail: Freeze the candidate. Use rotating promotion checks and final blind testing for quality, risk, cost and transfer. Retain the previous version on failure.

steps.label: Deploy & feed back
steps.detail: Only accepted versions enter the next round. Separately test whether the new system participates in later improvement and whether improvement efficiency increases.

selftrain.title: STaR / ReST-EM · generate, filter, learn
selftrain.object: Generator, selected traces and trained artifacts
selftrain.fixed: Questions, answer/execution truth and paper-specific schedules
selftrain.note: A shared outline, not identical algorithms. STaR's answer-conditioned rationalization differs from ReST-EM's E/M schedule. Preserve base-model resets.

steps.label: Retain external truth
steps.detail: Keep questions, known answers or tests. Traces are self-generated; the existing supervision must not be described as truth created from nothing.

steps.label: Sample solutions
steps.detail: Fix the current-stage policy and generate multiple answers or programs. Record the sampling budget; more sampling can itself improve results.

steps.label: Filter successful traces
steps.detail: Retain samples passing answer or program checks. STaR may rationalize failed questions using answer hints, then remove those hints from training inputs.

steps.label: Supervised update
steps.detail: Follow each paper's initialization and training schedule. Correct answers do not guarantee faithful reasoning; finite SGD provides no monotonic test guarantee.

steps.label: Evaluate independently
steps.detail: Measure quality and cost on data not used for filtering. Compare multiround training with larger single-round sampling at the same total budget.

steps.label: Generate again
steps.detail: The updated generator produces next-round data. Persistent feedback may exist even when the improvement procedure stays entirely fixed.

selfplay.title: Absolute Zero · executable task self-play
selfplay.fixed: Executor, task interfaces and human-defined rewards
selfplay.note: No matching human training dataset does not mean no pretraining, human design or external constraints.

steps.label: Propose a task
steps.detail: Generate executable challenges within a specified program-task space. Task interfaces bound the capabilities that can be explored.

steps.label: Check executability
steps.detail: Establish checkable information by execution and validate format and validity. An executor covers only properties in its specification.

steps.label: Attempt solutions
steps.detail: Solve admitted tasks and retain attempts, failures and outputs, not only rewarded samples.

steps.label: Construct role rewards
steps.detail: Build training signals from validity, difficulty and solution outcomes. Reward functions are design choices, not open-world truth.

steps.label: Learn the policies
steps.detail: Update proposal and solution capabilities while measuring the task distribution. Guard against easier tasks, shrinking coverage and executor exploits.

steps.label: Create new challenges
steps.detail: The new policies change subsequent tasks and traces. Evaluate external distributions rather than treating rising endogenous reward as general capability growth.

skills.title: Skills · persistent tools & experience
skills.object: Skills, tools, retrieval and applicability conditions
skills.fixed: Base model and workflow; check the specific method
skills.note: An authored synthesis of Yunjue/Voyager-like structures. Their environments and validation differ. No exception does not mean task correctness.

steps.label: Retrieve existing skills
steps.detail: Retrieve executable programs and experience by task conditions. Record retrieval cost and false matches; old skills need not transfer.

steps.label: Compose & execute
steps.detail: Compose available tools. Distinguish runtime exceptions, functional errors and failure of the final task.

steps.label: Diagnose a real gap
steps.detail: Generate a skill only for a genuine capability gap. Not every failure means the tool library is too small.

steps.label: Generate & validate
steps.detail: Run isolated and functional tests. Record dependencies, provenance, versions and applicability conditions.

steps.label: Merge & version
steps.detail: Cluster, merge, regression-test and version assets. Remove redundant or stale skills to avoid entrenching incorrect knowledge.

steps.label: Reuse on later tasks
steps.detail: Test unseen tasks and environments. Discuss improvement feedback only if the new library also participates in subsequent skill acquisition.

harness.title: HarnessPro · performance–cost frontier
harness.object: Prompts, skills, tools and control structure
harness.fixed: Once-generated tests, performance floor, backbone and official test
harness.note: Generated tests are produced once and fixed. Three Pareto representatives are not one universally best candidate. Separate search and deployment cost.

steps.label: Collect initial traces
steps.detail: Collect initial harness traces on coreset and validation tasks. DPP selection balances difficulty and diversity.

steps.label: Freeze generated tests
steps.detail: Generate tests once from tasks and initial traces, then record the performance floor. Generated tests can inherit mistaken assumptions.

steps.label: Diagnose & edit
steps.detail: Multiple roles inspect errors, redundancy and cost, proposing harness edits with different quality–cost priorities.

steps.label: Evaluate on fixed tests
steps.detail: Use the same generated tests for old and new candidates. Measure pass rate and execution expense; reject candidates below the performance floor.

steps.label: Keep frontier options
steps.detail: Remove dominated candidates, then select lite, medium and heavy representatives by normalized weighted squared distance for different budgets.

steps.label: Feed back & blind-test
steps.detail: Representatives enter the next epoch. Freeze final artifacts for official testing; development-frontier gains need not transfer to held-out data.

dream.title: Dream-RSI · replay & online discovery
dream.fixed: Base discovery agent, evaluator and execution interfaces
dream.note: Replay supports only recorded trees and valid prefixes. It is not a learned neural world model and cannot unbiasedly evaluate arbitrary unseen actions.

steps.label: Discover online
steps.detail: An exploration policy orchestrates a fixed discovery agent, runs expensive experiments and records a discovery-history tree with costs.

steps.label: Build replay worlds
steps.detail: Turn completed trees into deterministic replay environments. Prefix-only observations prevent access to history not yet revealed.

steps.label: Propose policy code
steps.detail: Revise selection, budget allocation and exploration behavior in candidate policy code. The base agent remains fixed.

steps.label: Compare on history
steps.detail: Compare quality–cost preferences and parallelism penalties on the same recorded support. Including the current policy provides a floor only within that history.

steps.label: Freeze the selection
steps.detail: Retain an appropriate policy and its offline evaluation. Lower replay expense does not make proposal or total discovery costs zero.

steps.label: Expand online again
steps.detail: Deploy the selected policy and record new discoveries. Separately test offline-ranking/online-gain agreement and failure outside recorded support.

meta.title: MetaRSI · operators, axes & scheduling
meta.object: Data, harnesses, trained artifacts, proposals and scheduling
meta.fixed: Protected execution/evaluation kernel and outer meta-policy
meta.note: A paper-structure illustration. Open-ended science is an agenda; experiments focus on code and closed-form science. Three operators are not three recursion levels.

steps.label: Observe diagnostics
steps.detail: The shared kernel collects system failures and evidence. Using one target model for several roles does not remove shared errors.

steps.label: Schedule horizontally
steps.detail: Choose typed compositions of Data-RSI, Harness-RSI and Model-RSI using fresh evidence for current versions.

steps.label: Revise proposals vertically
steps.detail: Optimize operator proposal strategies. Harness changes do not update weights; Model candidates train from the base and accumulated data as specified.

steps.label: Execute & select
steps.detail: Protected code validates boundaries, executes, selects and exports. Permission to propose is not permission to publish.

steps.label: Update term scheduling
steps.detail: Use complete term results to revise routing, budgets, stopping and vertical-optimization timing. The outer mechanism remains fixed and recursion depth finite.

steps.label: Test paired continuations
steps.detail: Fork the same system and compare subsequent gains of old/new improvers at equal budgets. Audit held-out access dependencies across terms.

coevo.title: CoEvo-RSI · model–harness inheritance
coevo.object: Model checkpoints, harnesses and trajectory data
coevo.fixed: Task evaluation and preregistered experimental budgets
coevo.note: A structural outline from the abstract and inherited topical evidence. Co-evolution does not automatically establish continuing acceleration.

steps.label: Read the shared archive
steps.detail: The meta-agent reads historical harnesses, checkpoints and execution feedback, retaining both successful and failed lineages.

steps.label: Inherit harness designs
steps.detail: Use earlier designs to propose a current harness rather than always starting over or locking into one lineage.

steps.label: Select or merge models
steps.detail: Select historical checkpoints or merge capabilities. Do not assume the newest model is always the most suitable.

steps.label: Adapt with trajectories
steps.detail: Collect rejection-sampled self-trajectories under the selected harness and use SFT to align the model with execution requirements.

steps.label: Test model–harness fit
steps.detail: Cross-evaluate old/new models with old/new harnesses under fixed search, training and execution resources to isolate joint benefits.

steps.label: Retain both histories
steps.detail: Admit qualifying pairs to the archive for later inheritance. Track generalization and improvement cost, not only current application scores.

evaluation.title: Evaluators · calibrate, freeze & audit
evaluation.object: Candidate evaluators, feedback rules and calibration assets
evaluation.fixed: Independent audits, final reporting, permissions and specifications
evaluation.note: An authored recommended protocol for family E, not a universal paper implementation. Higher evaluator self-scores do not establish correctness.

steps.label: Record feedback failures
steps.detail: Collect reward exploits, judge disagreements, missing tests and real task failures. Separate scorer errors, missing specifications and solver errors.

steps.label: Build calibration assets
steps.detail: Use independent sources, executable truth or human-adjudicated examples. State the evaluator's applicability and uncertainty.

steps.label: Propose evaluator edits
steps.detail: Update judges, tests or reward models through permitted interfaces. Keep versions and sources; the evaluated system cannot edit final reporting rules.

steps.label: Calibrate independently
steps.detail: Test reliability, error, adversarial robustness and new distributions. Compare with the prior evaluator and report false positives and negatives.

steps.label: Freeze & authorize
steps.detail: An external admission process decides deployment. Rejected candidates leave the prior evaluator in place; self-scoring cannot authorize promotion.

steps.label: Audit successor chains
steps.detail: The evaluator may enter permitted development loops, but final reporting remains isolated. Repeated cross-generation access and evaluator drift require continuing checks.

rsiopt.title: RSI-Opt · cross-run policies & adaptation
rsiopt.object: Prompts, playbooks, code libraries and decision cadence
rsiopt.fixed: LLM, meta-agent instructions, task splits, evaluation and decision count
rsiopt.note: A fixed meta-agent revises optimizer-agent policies; it does not edit itself. Valid weaker candidates also enter the archive. Audit historical held-out exposure and costs.

steps.label: Select a parent policy
steps.detail: Sample from the evaluated archive, favoring higher scores while discouraging repeated expansion of one branch.

steps.label: Edit cross-run assets
steps.detail: The fixed meta-agent uses run summaries to revise prompts, playbooks, optimizer code and timing. CPU proxy experiments may inform proposals.

steps.label: Validate structure
steps.detail: Check template fields, syntax and size; invalid candidates receive bounded repair. Passing format checks does not prove functional improvement.

steps.label: Adapt during training
steps.detail: The inner agent observes losses and diagnostics, edits the updater and runs short trials. Architecture, data and update count stay fixed; final metrics are withheld.

steps.label: Evaluate & archive
steps.detail: The outer loop reads final metrics on matched tasks/seeds. Every valid candidate is archived, including weaker ones. Standardized scores are not significance tests.

steps.label: Inherit & test transfer
steps.detail: Successors inherit experience and tools. Test held-out tasks and cross-model transfer; independent matched-budget proposal controls remain an important gap.

unresolved_sources.title: Towards AI That Improves Itself: A Survey of Recursive Self-Improvement
unresolved_sources.reading_scope: Original PDF URL requested; redirected to an OpenReview browser-verification challenge. Paper contents were not accessible.

title.en: From Retained Changes to Testable Improvement Capability
title.zh: 从可保留的改变到可检验的改进能力

executive_summary.en:
Recursive self-improvement should be studied as an evidence-bearing transition between persistent systems, not as repeated prompting or a rising benchmark curve. This chapter synthesizes three secondary readings while citing their underlying primary literature. It distinguishes broad self-improvement research from narrow recursion, structural mechanism reuse from effective improvement, and saved artifacts from assets actually consumed by successors.

The synthesis compares the AI4AI survey’s ownership, grounding and reliability axes; the Genuine RSI paper’s responsibility and inheritance framework; and the Self-Developing Agents project’s target, experience and system integration problems. None maps directly onto the Atlas’s operational A–F families.

A common state–update–feedback–successor model connects self-training, reinforcement learning, self-play, distillation, curricula, memory, harness search, Pareto retention, evaluator evolution and meta-coevolution. Twenty-nine methods are compared by update target, feedback, persistent asset, frozen boundary, evidence and cost.

Four recent works illustrate distinct advances: Harness² accumulates evidence-backed improvement experience; Evo² trains the evolver while freezing the executor; RRSI regularizes search; and OO-Harness combines specialization, inheritance and protected routing. Their reported gains are not independent replications or universal recursion claims.

Practical guidance prioritizes feedback availability, total lifecycle cost, transfer, negative results and paired continuation experiments. The central open question is whether inherited mechanisms produce better future successors under comparable resources and independent evaluation.
executive_summary.zh:
RSI 不是重复提示或一条上涨曲线，而是有证据的持久状态转移。本综述综合三份完整研读材料，把更新对象、改进责任、反馈依据、实际继承与后继效用分开讨论；AI4AI、Genuine RSI、Self-Developing Agents 的原有坐标不与 A–F 家族强行一一对应。

通过十类算法模板与二十九项方法矩阵，比较训练、课程、记忆、技能、Harness、评价器和元改进如何利用不同反馈，更新何种资产，保留哪些冻结层。四项近期重点工作分别展示经验积累、改进器训练、正则化搜索以及特化继承与回退，不能拼成通用排行榜。

选路从瓶颈、可用反馈与可撤回的最小更新开始；评价要包含研发和部署的完整成本、负结果、迁移以及同起点、同信息、同预算的配对继续实验。文中作者报告不冒充独立复现。

survey.taxonomy_semantics: Operational analytical families, not a field standard or a paper's native taxonomy.

summary.zh: 区分输出修订、持久自我改进与元机制递归。后继者必须实际使用已接受的改变，文件保存与代码可编辑都不足以证明继承。
summary.en: Separate output revision, persistent adaptation and recursive mechanism changes. Successors must actually consume accepted updates; saved files and editable code alone do not establish inheritance.

question.zh: 下一轮读取了什么，又因此改变了什么决定？
question.en: What does the next round consume, and which decision changes because of it?

title.zh: 四套坐标，不做强行映射

summary.zh: AI4AI 分解对象、所有权与证据；Genuine RSI 追踪责任与继承；Self-Developing Agents 拆解目标、经验和系统。A–F 只帮助定位更新载体。
summary.en: AI4AI separates targets, ownership and evidence; Genuine RSI tracks responsibility and inheritance; Self-Developing Agents examines targets, experience and systems. A–F locates update surfaces, not autonomy levels.

question.zh: 改什么、谁决定、凭什么相信，是否被混成一个标签？
question.en: Are update targets, decision ownership and evidence being collapsed into one label?

summary.zh: 比较自训练、RL、自博弈与蒸馏：成功样本、奖励、对手和教师分别从哪里获得信息？同模型教师看到答案，仍然属于特权监督。
summary.en: Compare self-training, RL, self-play and distillation by their information sources. A same-model teacher with answer access still supplies privileged supervision.

question.zh: 收益来自学习机制，还是额外样本、答案或计算？
question.en: Does the gain come from learning, or from extra samples, answers or compute?

summary.zh: 任务正确、当前困难与未来有学习价值是三个变量。环境或课程的难度上升，不能代替能力覆盖和独立迁移。
summary.en: Task correctness, current difficulty and future learning value are distinct. Increasing curriculum difficulty does not establish broader capability or independent transfer.

question.zh: 生成器是否利用当前能力，选择值得获取的下一批经验？
question.en: Does the generator use current capability to select valuable future experience?

summary.zh: 历史、摘要、程序技能与参数适应有不同失真方式。可读摘要不一定保留精确状态，检索命中与机制触发也不等于因果收益。
summary.en: History, summaries, executable skills and parameter adaptation fail differently. Readable summaries may discard critical state; retrieval and activation do not by themselves establish causal benefit.

question.zh: 资产是否经过读取、激活、执行和独立效果检查？
question.en: Was the asset retrieved, activated, executed and independently evaluated?

summary.zh: 提示、工作流、完整代码和特化类需要不同验证。多谱系或 Pareto 保留提供选择权，却增加搜索、兼容性与路由成本。
summary.en: Prompts, workflows, full code and specialized classes require different validation. Archives and Pareto retention preserve options while adding search, compatibility and routing costs.

question.zh: 保留的是互补机制，还是同一代理指标上的多个幸运赢家？
question.en: Are retained candidates complementary mechanisms or merely lucky proxy winners?

title.zh: 评价器可以变，比较尺度不能丢

summary.zh: 内部裁判可更新，但必须保留外层锚点、轮内冻结和换尺后的重评。反复返回聚合分，也会产生适应性选择信息。
summary.en: Internal evaluators may evolve, but require protected anchors, within-round freezing and rescoring after replacement. Repeated aggregate scores also provide adaptive selection information.

question.zh: 跨代增长来自能力提高，还是评价标准漂移？
question.en: Does cross-generation growth reflect capability or a moving evaluator?

title.zh: 四项新作，四种不同落点
title.en: Four Focus Works, Four Different Levers

summary.zh: Harness² 积累改进经验；Evo² 训练改进者并冻结执行器；RRSI 约束搜索路径；OO-Harness 组织特化与回退。不能合成一张通用排行榜。
summary.en: Harness² accumulates improvement experience; Evo² trains the evolver with a frozen executor; RRSI regularizes search; OO-Harness organizes specialization and fallback. They do not form a universal leaderboard.

question.zh: 各自更新什么、冻结什么，反馈何时可见？
question.en: What changes, what stays frozen, and when is feedback visible?

summary.zh: 先判断瓶颈和反馈可得性，再选择参数、记忆、技能或运行时。研发成本、部署成本、并行延迟与摊销假设必须分别报告。
summary.en: Locate the bottleneck and available feedback before choosing parameters, memory, skills or runtime edits. Separate development cost, deployment cost, parallel latency and amortization assumptions.

question.zh: 哪一种最小、可撤回的改变足以检验当前假设？
question.en: What is the smallest reversible change that tests the current hypothesis?

summary.zh: 让新旧改进器从共同起点、相同信息与总预算继续工作，独立评价后继者。负结果、回滚、基线回退和最佳—最终差距都是核心证据。
summary.en: Run old and new improvers from common starts with matched information and total budgets, then independently evaluate successors. Failures, rollback, fallback and best–final gaps are central evidence.

question.zh: 更强的是当前产物，还是产生未来改进的能力？
question.en: Is the current artifact better, or is the ability to improve future artifacts better?

framework_axes.summary: D1 target; D2 self-reference; D3 stage ownership; D4 signal grounding; D5 measured gain/retention/human comparison/held-out transfer.
Separate pressure, closure, evidence. Six pressure coordinates: human-effort time, interaction length, context/memory, grounding, planning dependency, verification observability.

limits.summary: Composition gap; weak causal judgment, independent research direction and compounding evidence. Audit sample is purposive, capped search incomplete, no two completed human annotations.

sections.title: 6. Repair and Optimization of Existing Systems

framework_axes.summary: Two overlapping engineering goals: infrastructure design; repair/optimization of existing systems. Six target sectors: weights, tasks, memory, programs, feedback, improver.
Functional retained solver S and improver I; task gain, retention/transfer, improver gain require different probes.

what_mutates.summary: Data and parameters, memories and skills, prompts/programs/harnesses, judges, update processes or recursive context; functional roles can share implementation.

feedback.summary: Answers, execution, environmental outcomes, model judgments and human input differentiated by use in generation, training and selection; new external information is part of the mechanism.

sections.title: 5. System Security, Resilience, Privacy, and Data Governance
A. Literature Coverage and Citation Scope

framework_axes.summary: Functional policy h, inductive bias B, bias-update function U; diagnosis/proposal/evaluation/implementation S1–S4 and recursive application to U (RI).
Four themes under Improvement Validity, Constraint Preservation, Effective Oversight; update/successor/meta-improvement claim levels; eight requirement groups.

what_mutates.summary: Policy weights/prompts/memory/skills; bias governing data selection, objectives or learning; updater governing revisions of bias. A shared module can have multiple roles.

feedback.summary: Experience E and performance/improvement feedback F; independent reporting separated from acceptance feedback reused for improvement.

ownership.summary: Human approval may remain. Changed goals/requirements require authorization; candidate cannot be sole approval authority over safeguards or control roots.

recursion.summary: Strict RSI revises and reuses U, not merely policy h or learned bias B. Promptbreeder illustrates changing B under fixed U in this functional boundary.

evaluation.summary: Paired fixed-updater continuations from equal h/B/persistent state; same reporting tests and continuation budget; discovery/validation cost separately included in total-cost efficiency; joint criteria must hold on aligned trajectories.

limits.summary: Direct RI, general persistent evolution and related fixed-system risk evidence are distinct. Study-level coverage is not joint evidence from the same trajectory.
Search through Oct 26; 301 works and 260 evidence cells are stated corpus counts, not field prevalence.

negative_evidence.summary: Self-authored tests can remain favorable while protected deployment performance worsens; grader drift or shared errors can inflate gains.
Poisoned Hyperagents benchmark leads to inherited insecure task instructions; clean further evolution does not necessarily remove them. Demonstrated target edits do not isolate U revision.

sections.title: 2 Foundations of Recursive Self-Improving AI and Evolutionary Safety

framework_axes.summary: Persistence, mutable scope, loop closure are independent; variation/selection/inheritance motivate evolutionary risk.
Five domains: persistent agent state; model state; evaluation/environmental feedback; computational substrate; meta-level updates/co-evolution.
Six manifestations: intent drift, error accumulation/amplification, experience contamination, safety erosion, evaluator drift/selection distortion, risk inheritance/propagation.

what_mutates.summary: Agent artifacts, learned parameters, execution substrate, evaluator/updater and reciprocal learning conditions. Reciprocal adaptation need not modify individual update rules.

feedback.summary: Environmental experience and candidate selection feedback distinguished; frozen references and overlapping evaluator versions preserve comparability.

ownership.summary: Modifications, verification and authorization must have enforceable boundaries; proposing a change is not authority to approve it.

recursion.summary: Persistent system adaptation need not revise the update procedure. Updater revision and reciprocal adaptation are different meta-level mechanisms.

evaluation.summary: State/update/trajectory/lineage units; exposure-aware risk, source removal, repaired-state continuation, frozen-channel causal comparisons, candidate selection risk shift.

limits.summary: Shared descendant failures alone do not demonstrate transmission; provenance gives possible routes, interventions/descendant tests stronger evidence. Newly discovered failure need not be newly caused.
Governance and composition guarantees remain conditional; restoration of software state does not undo physical effects.

negative_evidence.summary: Capability can improve while safety erodes; evaluator drift can mimic improvement. Risk accumulation must distinguish extra exposure from per-opportunity degradation.

papers.title: Safety in Self-Evolving Agents: A Survey
papers.latest_version_check: Official abstract and PDF margin say v1, 8 Sep 2026; PDF body separately says Date: October 2, 2026. Unresolved inconsistency; identifier month is not used to overwrite either date.

framework_axes.summary: SAVER pairs Substrate × Adaptation then traces Violation, Exposure, Response; ordering is analytical, not mandatory chronology or required delay before prevention.
Seven operations: add, abstract, activate, modify, forget, propagate, migrate; selection before commitment and response feedback beyond the transition.

what_mutates.summary: Reusable memory/context, skills/tools, workflow/routing, shared artifacts and agent-loop model-side state. Same content can change authority, scope and persistence when moved between carriers.

feedback.summary: Utility is distinct from authorization. Legitimate local experience can lose source/use constraints during abstraction; adversarial and endogenous drift tracks should be separate.

ownership.summary: Storage permission is not activation authority; grants depend on current user/task/effect/context. Governance state also needs protected lineage and renewed authorization.

recursion.summary: Scope broader than strict RSI: reusable influence evolving inside the agent loop matters even if updater fixed; context accumulation without persistent update is a different mechanism.

evaluation.summary: Stage-specific opportunity sets; containment != repair. Seed/adapt/delay/trigger/expose/repair/probe/continue contract; descendants and resumed adaptation define spatial/temporal scope of recovery.

limits.summary: Frozen coding pool 683 papers, 549 low-confidence placements; scoping survey not preregistered, no independent dual screening. Counts not prevalence and corpus freeze Sep 4 distinct from later prose evidence.
Missing triggers do not establish safe retained state; connected trace or merged coverage table does not establish joint repair or permanent protection.

negative_evidence.summary: SkillMisevo/SafeEvolve: online benign utility 58.44→58.00%, carryover utility 53.33→40.67%; immediate utility cost differs from reuse cost.
PASB 45.0 vs 71.9% observed downstream failure groups are not randomized memory-disabled controls; group contrast not causal effect of memory.

source.title: RSI递归自我改进开源工程汇总（工作簿内容整理）

purpose.en: Find systems that revise the execution layer around an agent: prompts, tools, routing, workflows and persistent assets.
purpose.zh: 查找改进智能体执行外围的工程：提示、工具、路由、工作流及持久资产。

read_guide.en: Identify editable components, trace feedback, candidate retention and the outer optimizer. Check each row before assuming frozen weights.
read_guide.zh: 先看可编辑组件、轨迹反馈、候选保留及外层优化器；逐项确认，不能因分类名称就假定权重冻结。

caveat.en: Harness edits are not weight training or necessarily edits to the improver itself. Some rows explicitly mix weight updates or optional training. A–F tags are an editorial, overlapping reading crosswalk, not workbook taxonomy or proof that every project changes those states.
caveat.zh: Harness 编辑不等于权重训练，也不一定修改改进器自身；部分条目明确混合权重更新或可选训练。A–F 只是编辑性、多标签阅读对照，不是工作簿分类，也不是每个项目均改变这些状态的证据。

purpose.en: Compare agents that edit their own implementation, tools or improvement procedures, including archive-based evolutionary variants.
purpose.zh: 比较编辑自身实现、工具或改进流程的智能体，包括维护进化档案的变体。

read_guide.en: Distinguish task-agent code from meta-agent code; locate evaluation, isolation, parent selection and the exact mutation boundary.
read_guide.zh: 区分任务智能体代码与元智能体代码，定位评估、隔离、父代选择和实际修改边界。

caveat.en: Runtime plugin replacement or tool creation only supplies mutability; it does not establish measured improvement. Benchmark-selected self-edits are not a formal Gödel-machine optimality proof. The A–F crosswalk is editorial and many-to-many.
caveat.zh: 热替换插件或临时创建工具只提供可变性，不证明能力提高；基准选择的自身编辑也不是哥德尔机最优性证明。A–F 对照属于编辑判断，采用多对多关系。

purpose.en: Locate searches that use language-model proposals to improve executable programs, heuristics or mathematical constructions.
purpose.zh: 定位利用语言模型提议来改进可执行程序、启发式或数学构造的搜索工程。

read_guide.en: Inspect the candidate representation, evaluator, population diversity and budget. Separate changing a solution from changing its search strategy.
read_guide.zh: 查看候选表示、评估器、种群多样性及预算；区分解的变化和搜索策略自身的变化。

caveat.en: An evolving program population can be driven by a fixed outer optimizer. Neither improved algorithms nor the AlphaEvolve name implies a recursively improving model. Some rows also train weights or rewrite exploration policy; A–F tags are editorial context.
caveat.zh: 程序种群进化可以由固定外层优化器驱动；算法变好或使用 AlphaEvolve 名称，不代表模型递归变强。部分项目另有权重训练或探索策略重写；A–F 标签仅提供编辑性的关联阅读。

purpose.en: Compare parameter-learning loops using generated data, self-play, preference signals, curricula or adaptation at test time.
purpose.zh: 比较以自生成数据、自博弈、偏好信号、课程或测试时适应驱动的参数学习循环。

read_guide.en: Identify which model is trained, initialization, supervision, reward validity and dependencies. Distinguish inference, data curation and actual parameter updates.
read_guide.zh: 确认训练哪个模型、初始化、监督来源、奖励有效性及依赖，区分推理、数据策划和实际参数更新。

caveat.en: Self-generated supervision is not supervision-free learning, and training a solver does not show that its optimizer improves itself. Test-time weight updates differ from text or memory adaptation. The overlapping A–F tags are editorial, not additional source categories.
caveat.zh: 自生成监督不等于无监督来源，训练求解器也不证明优化器会改进自身。测试时权重更新应与文本或记忆适应区分。交叉的 A–F 标签是编辑对照，不新增来源分类。

purpose.en: Find optimizers over prompts, natural-language skills, playbooks and other textual parameters that can support larger agent loops.
purpose.zh: 查找优化提示、自然语言技能、策略手册及其他文本参数的工具，理解其如何支撑更大的智能体循环。

read_guide.en: Identify the text variable, feedback, proposal operator and validation split. Some frameworks can also edit code or configuration.
read_guide.zh: 确认文本变量、反馈、提议算子和验证划分；部分框架还允许编辑代码或配置。

caveat.en: Textual gradients, epochs and skill 'training' do not by themselves mean neural-weight updates. A fixed reflective optimizer is not automatically meta-recursive; persistent cheatsheets are memory rather than retrained models. A–F links are editorial and overlapping.
caveat.zh: 文本梯度、epoch 或技能“训练”本身不代表神经权重更新。固定反思优化器不自动构成元递归；持久小抄是记忆，而非重新训练的模型。A–F 关联为编辑性、多标签对照。

purpose.en: Find systems that turn interactions or execution traces into reusable memories, skills, ontology updates or executable subagents.
purpose.zh: 查找将交互或执行轨迹沉淀为可复用记忆、技能、本体更新或可执行子智能体的系统。

read_guide.en: Track what persists, how it is retrieved or revised, and how incorrect assets are rejected. Separate personalization from general capability gains.
read_guide.zh: 追踪保存什么、如何检索与修订、怎样淘汰错误资产，并区分个性化与通用能力提升。

caveat.en: Accumulating or retrieving more memory is not sufficient evidence of better reasoning, weight learning or recursive source-code improvement. User feedback, asset validation and maintenance status remain material qualifiers. A–F assignments are an editorial reading aid.
caveat.zh: 记忆增加或检索增强，不足以证明推理变强、权重学习或源码递归改进。用户反馈、资产验证与维护状态仍是重要限定。A–F 归属只是编辑性的阅读辅助。

purpose.en: Compare experiment loops and research assistants spanning hypotheses, code, measured experiments, evidence management and writing.
purpose.zh: 比较涵盖假设、代码、实测实验、证据管理及写作的研究助手与实验循环。

read_guide.en: Locate the actual measured artifact, acceptance rule and human role. Distinguish a host-dependent skill from a standalone research engine.
read_guide.zh: 定位真正测量的制品、接受规则和人的角色；区分依赖宿主的技能与独立科研引擎。

caveat.en: Automating research does not necessarily improve the researcher, model or research policy. Metric optimization and generated papers are not scientific validity or open-ended discovery guarantees. Weight-harness co-improvement requires explicit evidence; A–F tags remain editorial.
caveat.zh: 自动做科研不一定改进科研者、模型或研究策略。指标优化与生成论文，不等于科学有效性或开放式发现保证；权重与 Harness 协同改进需要明确证据。A–F 仍属编辑对照。

purpose.en: Compare skill-building and memory-based adaptation in digital environments or physical robot tasks.
purpose.zh: 比较数字环境或实体机器人任务中的技能构建与记忆适应。

read_guide.en: Identify the environment, validation channel, skill representation and transfer boundary. Separate simulation, source-task learning and deployment on new tasks.
read_guide.zh: 确认环境、验证渠道、技能表示及迁移边界，区分仿真、源任务学习和新任务部署。

caveat.en: An environment is not itself necessarily evolving. Minecraft success, desktop exploration and robot transfer are different evidence scopes; a frozen skill stack on new tasks is not continuous recursive improvement there. A–F mappings are editorial.
caveat.zh: 环境本身不一定进化。Minecraft 成功、桌面探索及机器人迁移的证据范围不同；在新任务上使用冻结技能栈，不等于仍在持续递归改进。A–F 映射为编辑判断。

name.zh: RSI 与 AI 研发评测

purpose.en: Find tasks and scoring infrastructure for machine-learning engineering, paper replication, research and method improvement.
purpose.zh: 查找用于机器学习工程、论文复现、科研及方法改进的任务和评分基础设施。

read_guide.en: Read task scope, protected data and scoring rules before comparing results. Check whether the benchmark measures task performance or improvement of the improver.
read_guide.zh: 比较结果前先读任务范围、受保护数据和评分规则，确认测量的是任务表现还是改进器自身的改进。

caveat.en: Benchmarks measure submitted systems; they are not automatically self-improving systems. AI-R&D competence is not a demonstration of recursive capability. Recent commits do not negate a deprecation notice. A–F tags describe editorial assessment context, not benchmark mutations.
caveat.zh: 基准测量提交的系统，本身不自动是自改进系统。AI 研发能力不等于递归能力已被证明；近期提交也不推翻弃用声明。A–F 标签描述编辑性的评测关联，不表示基准在修改这些状态。

purpose.en: Find experiments and controls addressing reward exploitation, harmful evolution and drift in reusable skill libraries.
purpose.zh: 查找针对奖励利用、危险进化及可复用技能库漂移的实验和控制机制。

read_guide.en: Identify the precise specification, checker, threat model and retirement rule. Separate a risk study from an operational safeguard.
read_guide.zh: 确认具体规范、检查器、威胁模型和退役规则；区分风险研究与运行时防护。

caveat.en: Proof checking establishes only properties encoded in a specification, not universal 'uncheatability' or safety. Skill retirement is bounded governance, not a comprehensive guarantee. Risk experiments need not improve an agent. The A–F crosswalk is editorial and many-to-many.
caveat.zh: 证明检查只支持规范中编码的性质，不保证普遍“无法作弊”或安全。技能退役属于有限治理，不是全面保证；风险实验也不一定改进智能体。A–F 为编辑性的多对多对照。

projects.summary_zh: 自我改进的 AI 智能体，内置学习闭环（“与你一同成长”）
projects.summary_en: Hermes Agent turns task experience into skills, retains knowledge and retrieves earlier interactions to personalize future work. The workbook describes a broad assistant application with persistent memory, but its self-improvement branding should be read as asset-based adaptation rather than proven recursive capability.
projects.mechanism_zh: 从经验中创建技能并在使用中改进，主动持久化知识并检索历史
projects.implementation_zh: 大型完整工程（CLI、消息网关、桌面应用）
projects.caveat_zh: “与你一同成长”是产品定位；技能记忆及用户模型积累不能直接等同权重训练或已证明递归自增强。

projects.summary_zh: 让 AI 智能体在单 GPU nanochat 训练上自动做研究
projects.summary_en: Autoresearch directs a coding agent to modify a small language-model training program, run fixed-duration experiments and retain or revert changes according to evaluation. The workbook describes an instruction-guided research loop, not a researcher that necessarily improves its own weights.
projects.mechanism_zh: 智能体按 program.md 修改训练代码 → 固定时长训练评估 → 保留或回退，持续循环
projects.implementation_zh: 极简完整工程（prepare.py、train.py、program.md）
projects.caveat_zh: 改进对象是 train.py 与实验指标；训练被研究的模型不等于训练研究 Agent，固定外层保留／回退规则不必自改写。

projects.summary_zh: 面向 AI 智能体的自进化上下文数据库
projects.summary_en: OpenViking organizes agent memories, knowledge and skills through a filesystem-style context layer. Event-driven extraction, updating and consolidation keep long-term material available for later use; the workbook describes a context database, not an agent that necessarily improves its own optimizer.
projects.target_zh: 记忆、知识与技能上下文
projects.mechanism_zh: 事件驱动的长期记忆抽取 / 更新 / 整合，以文件系统范式统一上下文
projects.implementation_zh: 完整工程（AGPL-3.0）
projects.attribution_zh: 字节跳动 火山引擎
projects.caveat_zh: 上下文数据库更新不等于 Agent 推理能力递归提升；AGPL 是来源快照中的许可标签，不能自动推断所有制品许可。

projects.summary_zh: 【参考项目】开放世界递归 Agent Harness 优化框架，在模型权重固定下迭代改进执行 harness
projects.summary_en: Harness² coordinates comparative task refinement with persistent improvements to prompts, tools, memory, skills and execution components around a frozen model. The workbook describes parallel or serial recursion, local demonstrations and benchmark-running utilities, rather than neural parameter training.
projects.target_zh: Harness 八类组件：系统提示、护栏、记忆、工具指引、子代理、技能、脚本、插件
projects.mechanism_zh: 任务级 Propose–Probe–Compose 对比式精炼（无需真值反馈）+ Harness 级持久“改进 harness”沉淀经验；支持并行/串行递归
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 包（pyproject、CLI、测试），含免凭据本地演示及 JobBench / LAB / WorkBuddy-Bench 运行与评测脚本
projects.caveat_zh: 这是工作簿的参考 Harness² 项目，不是基因组 Evo2，也不应与权重–Harness 协同进化的 Evo² 混同；对比式探查无需真值，不代表结果已经独立验证。

projects.summary_zh: SkillOpt：为冻结 LLM 智能体训练可复用自然语言技能的文本空间优化器
projects.summary_en: SkillOpt edits reusable natural-language skill documents from agent trajectories, organizing text optimization with batches, epochs and validation gates. The workbook explicitly places the base model in a frozen setting, so skill training here changes documents rather than neural parameters.
projects.mechanism_zh: 像训练神经网络一样使用 epoch、批次、学习率与验证门控做轨迹驱动编辑
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 框架 + WebUI + 插件 + 文档
projects.caveat_zh: epoch、批次和学习率属于文本优化类比；best_skill.md 变化不等于 LLM 权重更新。

projects.summary_zh: 自动化数据驱动 AI 研发（R&D）的智能体框架
projects.summary_en: RD Agent separates idea generation from implementation in a repeated research-and-development cycle over models, factors and data-science solutions. The workbook describes an application framework with interfaces and documentation, while improvement concerns research artifacts rather than necessarily the agent's own learning machinery.
projects.target_zh: 模型、因子与数据科学方案
projects.mechanism_zh: Research（提出想法）+ Development（实现）双智能体循环持续演进
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 包 + Web UI + 文档
projects.caveat_zh: 研究／开发循环推进方案，不自动证明科研 Agent 或优化器自身变强；模型、因子等目标须按场景区分。

projects.summary_zh: AI 科学家：迈向全自动开放式科学发现
projects.summary_en: AI Scientist chains idea generation, experiment execution, paper writing and automated reviewing in a templated research workflow. The workbook describes an end-to-end implementation, but completed papers and internal review do not independently establish scientific novelty or recursive improvement of the researcher.
projects.target_zh: 研究想法、实验代码与论文
projects.mechanism_zh: 想法生成 → 实验 → 写作 → 自动评审的端到端循环
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 工程 + 模板
projects.caveat_zh: 自动实验、写作和评审不等于科学结论可靠；“开放式发现”应保留为来源定位，不能扩成科研者自递归证明。

projects.summary_zh: 全自主、自进化的科研系统：输入想法，输出论文
projects.summary_en: AutoResearchClaw organizes multistage research from an initial idea toward experiments and a manuscript, including human collaboration and retained experience. The workbook describes application and interface code; its autonomy framing coexists with an explicit human role in the research process.
projects.mechanism_zh: 多阶段研究流水线 + 人机协作 + 自我强化
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 工程 + 前端
projects.caveat_zh: “全自主”与人机协作并存，不能删去人的角色；自我强化细节未展开，不擅自补成权重训练。

projects.summary_zh: 极简自进化自主智能体：从 3.3K 行种子代码长出技能树
projects.summary_en: GenericAgent starts with a small tool set and agent loop, then writes skills while handling tasks and preserves reflective experience. The workbook describes interfaces, plugins and memory around this skill-building process, rather than proof that the seed loop continually rewrites itself.
projects.mechanism_zh: 9 个原子工具 + 约 100 行 Agent Loop，在任务中自写技能并反思沉淀
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 工程（CLI、前端、插件、记忆）
projects.caveat_zh: 自写技能与技能树增长，不自动等于核心 Agent Loop 自修改或一般能力持续增长。

projects.summary_zh: 面向 LLM 与智能体的自进化记忆操作系统
projects.summary_en: MemOS combines layered memories with hybrid retrieval, cross-task skill reuse and feedback-sensitive retrieval. The workbook describes an application and plugins that support persistent agent context; the claimed evolution concerns memory assets and access patterns rather than necessarily neural-model retraining.
projects.target_zh: 多层记忆（轨迹 / 策略 / 世界模型 / 技能）
projects.mechanism_zh: 混合检索 + 跨任务技能复用 + 反馈驱动检索
projects.implementation_zh: 完整工程 + Hermes / OpenClaw 插件
projects.caveat_zh: 记忆层含世界模型或策略内容，不代表相应神经权重被更新；应保留检索与复用层面的机制限定。

projects.summary_zh: 基于 GEP 的智能体自进化引擎，进化过程可审计
projects.summary_en: Evolver organizes reusable evolution assets into genes, capsules and events, with an audit chain linking their history. The workbook describes a Node-based engine for memory and skills, while also flagging a transition from its listed license toward source-available distribution.
projects.target_zh: 记忆、技能与进化资产（Genes / Capsules）
projects.mechanism_zh: Genes、Capsules、Events 三类进化资产 + 审计链
projects.implementation_zh: Node.js 工程（GPL-3.0，正转向 source-available）
projects.caveat_zh: 审计链不证明每项资产有效；GPL-3.0 与转向 source-available 的说明存在许可边界，不能直接宣称当前 OSI 开源。

projects.summary_zh: AlphaEvolve 开源实现：LLM 驱动的进化式编码智能体
projects.summary_en: OpenEvolve uses language-model mutations with quality-diversity archives and island-based populations to search for better programs. Automatic evaluation selects candidates; the workbook describes a community implementation with examples and visualization, not the official AlphaEvolve research engine.
projects.mechanism_zh: MAP-Elites 质量-多样性 + 岛模型 + LLM 变异，自动评估与选择
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 包 + 大量示例 + Docker + 可视化
projects.caveat_zh: 这是社区实现，不是 DeepMind 官方引擎；固定进化搜索器下程序变好，不等于搜索器或模型自身递归变强。

projects.summary_zh: AI 科学家 v2：基于智能体树搜索的研讨会级自动科学发现
projects.summary_en: AI Scientist v2 uses progressive agentic tree search and experiment-management agents to explore research alternatives and produce manuscripts. The workbook describes a research implementation; search-guided experiment improvement is distinct from proof that the searcher or base model recursively improves itself.
projects.mechanism_zh: 渐进式智能体树搜索（BFTS）+ 实验管理智能体
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程
projects.caveat_zh: 基于树搜索的实验探索不等于外层搜索器自进化；“研讨会级”是来源定位，不保证任意论文质量。

projects.summary_zh: GEPA：基于反思与 Pareto 进化优化任意文本参数
projects.summary_en: GEPA reads execution traces to propose reflective changes to textual parameters and selects candidates using Pareto tradeoffs. The workbook notes prompts, code, architecture and configuration as possible targets, with integrations that make it an optimizer component rather than necessarily self-modifying machinery.
projects.target_zh: 提示词、代码、智能体架构、配置
projects.mechanism_zh: LLM 读取完整执行轨迹做反思式变异 + Pareto 前沿选择
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + Claude 插件 + 示例（已集成至 DSPy）
projects.caveat_zh: 支持任意文本制品不表示每次都编辑改进器；Pareto 选择及反思需要可信评估，不能自动声称元递归。

projects.summary_zh: Voyager：Minecraft 中的开放式具身终身学习智能体
projects.summary_en: Voyager explores Minecraft with an automatic curriculum, builds an executable skill library and refines actions using environment feedback and self-verification. The workbook describes a lifelong-learning agent whose retained skills, rather than mandatory model-weight updates, support later exploration.
projects.mechanism_zh: 自动课程 + 不断增长的技能库 + 迭代提示（环境反馈 / 自我验证）
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 工程
projects.caveat_zh: Minecraft 数字具身环境不等于真实机器人；技能库持续增长不保证核心模型或改进器本身递归增强。

projects.summary_zh: Autoresearch Skill：目标驱动的自主迭代（受 Karpathy autoresearch 启发）
projects.summary_en: This Autoresearch skill applies a constrained propose-and-measure loop to codebases with mechanically scored goals. The workbook describes integrations for coding-agent hosts, so it is a host-dependent optimization instruction and plugin layer rather than a standalone autonomous scientific engine.
projects.target_zh: 任意可度量目标的代码库
projects.mechanism_zh: 约束 + 机械指标 + 自主迭代循环
projects.implementation_zh: Agent Skill / 插件形式（Claude Code、OpenCode、Codex）
projects.caveat_zh: 这是受 Karpathy 启发的 Skill／插件，不是同一仓库；可度量代码目标不必是科学研究或递归改进器。

projects.summary_zh: Agents 2.0：以“符号学习”训练语言智能体的数据中心自进化框架
projects.summary_en: Agents represents an agent pipeline as editable nodes and tools, then propagates language-based feedback to revise prompts and structure. Its symbolic learning analogy concerns agent-system changes, with a Python package and examples described in the workbook.
projects.target_zh: Agent 流水线、节点提示词与工具
projects.mechanism_zh: 仿神经网络反向传播：语言损失 → 语言梯度 → 更新提示词、工具与流水线结构
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包（setup.py）+ 示例
projects.caveat_zh: “语言梯度”及符号学习不等于神经权重反向传播；工作簿未给最近提交，活跃度须保留未知。

projects.summary_zh: “Harness 的 Harness”：面向 RSI 的多智能体宿主，自动生成 DAG 编排多个专业 Agent
projects.summary_en: Raven provides a multiagent host that constructs execution graphs and proposes revisions to its planning and execution harness. Evaluation gates adoption, while an associated memory service supports continuity across sessions; the workbook lists interface, deployment and testing components.
projects.target_zh: Raven 自身 harness（规划与执行方式）
projects.mechanism_zh: 提出 harness 改动 → 评估 → 通过验证后采纳；EverOS 提供跨会话记忆与上下文
projects.implementation_zh: 完整工程：agents、evolver、benchmarks、TUI/Web UI、Docker 与测试
projects.caveat_zh: “Harness 的 Harness”是项目定位；验证门控和跨会话记忆不能单独证明改进器本身持续变强。

projects.summary_zh: AI-Researcher：自主科学创新
projects.summary_en: AI Researcher coordinates multiple agents from literature analysis through algorithm implementation to paper production. The workbook describes an application with benchmarks and deployment support, but the research pipeline alone does not show retained improvement to its own model or search policy.
projects.mechanism_zh: 从文献到算法实现再到论文的端到端多智能体
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 工程 + 基准 + Docker
projects.caveat_zh: 端到端科研编排不必改变科研者自身；原行许可证未声明，不能据名称宣称完整 OSI 开源授权。

projects.summary_zh: Agent Laboratory：以 LLM 智能体作为科研助理的端到端流程
projects.summary_en: Agent Laboratory organizes research-assistant stages for literature review, experiments and reporting, with a shared research-artifact channel. The workbook describes a complete application; accumulated outputs and collaboration should be distinguished from validated self-modification or model-weight learning by the laboratory agents.
projects.mechanism_zh: 多阶段研究智能体 + AgentRxiv 共享研究成果
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 工程
projects.caveat_zh: 科研助理与共享成果机制不自动构成科研者自进化；报告和论文需要独立事实、实验及质量检查。

projects.summary_zh: Hermes Agent 进化式自我改进：自动优化技能、工具描述、系统提示与代码
projects.summary_en: This Hermes companion implementation applies DSPy and GEPA search to skills, tool descriptions, system prompts and code. The workbook describes evolution, dataset and report components and explicitly avoids GPU training, distinguishing it from neural-weight updates in the primary model.
projects.target_zh: Hermes Agent 的技能、工具描述、系统提示与代码
projects.mechanism_zh: DSPy + GEPA 反思式进化搜索，无需 GPU 训练
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程（evolution、datasets、reports）
projects.caveat_zh: 与 hermes-agent 主工程是不同仓库；无需 GPU 的外围搜索不是模型训练，许可证未声明。

projects.summary_zh: Self-Instruct：用模型自身生成的指令数据对齐预训练模型
projects.summary_en: Self-Instruct bootstraps instruction, input and output examples from a pretrained model, filters the generated material and uses it for fine-tuning.
