The workbook describes scripts and data for improving instruction following, rather than an autonomously rewriting training algorithm.
projects.mechanism_zh: 自举生成指令/输入/输出 → 过滤 → 微调自身
projects.implementation_zh: Python 脚本 + 数据
projects.caveat_zh: 自生成训练数据仍依赖预训练模型与过滤流程；微调自身不代表优化器自身递归改进。

projects.summary_zh: TextGrad：通过文本实现自动“微分”
projects.summary_en: TextGrad represents prompts, answers or code as text variables and propagates language-model feedback through a computation structure. Its gradient analogy supports iterative textual revision; the workbook describes an installable library, not automatic mathematical differentiation through neural-weight training.
projects.target_zh: 提示词、解答、代码等文本变量
projects.mechanism_zh: LLM 文本反馈作为“梯度”进行反向传播优化
projects.implementation_zh: pip 可安装的 Python 库
projects.caveat_zh: “自动微分”和“梯度”在此是文本反馈类比；优化文本不意味着真实权重梯度或普遍效果保证。

projects.summary_zh: 把 Agent Skills 作为记忆层：自动从运行中捕获经验并沉淀为技能文件
projects.summary_en: Acontext extracts experience from agent execution traces and stores it as readable, editable skill files. The workbook describes a context service and dashboard, but explicitly says maintenance has stopped even though the activity field records a recent commit.
projects.target_zh: 技能文件（可读、可编辑、可共享）
projects.mechanism_zh: 运行轨迹 → 经验抽取 → 技能文件
projects.implementation_zh: 完整工程（src、dashboard、charts）；官方注明已停止维护
projects.caveat_zh: 来源同时写“已停止维护”和“活跃”；提交新近度不能覆盖维护终止声明，技能抽取也非递归能力证明。

projects.summary_zh: 构建、评估并自动进化 LLM 智能体与工作流的自进化生态框架
projects.summary_en: EvoAgentX builds agent workflows from task descriptions, evaluates them and connects existing optimizers for prompt and workflow evolution. It is described as an integration framework with examples and tests, not as evidence that every optimizer recursively rewrites itself.
projects.target_zh: 智能体工作流、提示词与结构
projects.mechanism_zh: 单条提示自动构建多智能体工作流 + 内置评估器 + 集成 TextGrad、MIPRO、AFlow 等进化算法
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 包 + 文档 + 示例 + 测试
projects.caveat_zh: 集成 TextGrad、MIPRO、AFlow 等方法是框架能力，不应写成已证明的元递归；不同优化器的实际修改范围需分别理解。

projects.summary_zh: Reflexion：基于语言强化学习的智能体
projects.summary_en: Reflexion converts failed or successful attempts into verbal reflections retained in episodic memory, which guide later retries. The workbook describes question-answering, environment and coding experiments; language-based reinforcement here changes remembered advice rather than requiring neural policy-gradient updates.
projects.target_zh: 情节记忆中的自我反思
projects.mechanism_zh: 试错后生成语言反思并存入记忆，指导后续尝试
projects.implementation_zh: Python 代码 + notebooks（HotPotQA / ALFWorld / 编程）
projects.caveat_zh: 语言强化学习在此主要指反思记忆，不等于神经 RL 参数训练；重试收益仍受任务与反馈限制。

projects.summary_zh: 统一稳定的 RSI 平台：模型固定、harness 进化，提供桌面/Web/CLI/SDK
projects.summary_en: Penguin Harness exposes a shared runtime and plugin surface for optimizing prompts, skills, tools and hooks around fixed models. Its workbook description emphasizes common benchmarks, scores and snapshots across imported optimization methods, with several application interfaces.
projects.mechanism_zh: 以插件形式集成 OPRO、APE、ACE、AWM、SkillOpt、OpenSkill、TRACE 等 RSI 算法，统一基准、计分板与快照
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 TypeScript 工程（packages / plugins）+ Docker + 场景测试
projects.caveat_zh: 统一插件和计分板不是递归能力证明；被集成算法的效果不能直接当作该平台自身已复现的结果。

projects.summary_zh: Codex 自主可度量实验技能
projects.summary_en: This Codex Autoresearch skill makes one targeted code change, validates a chosen metric, retains or reverts the result and repeats toward a goal. The workbook describes instructions and scripts, requiring a host agent rather than providing an independent optimizer runtime.
projects.target_zh: 代码库指标（测试、覆盖率、性能等）
projects.mechanism_zh: 改一处 → 验证 → 保留/回退 → 重复直至达标
projects.implementation_zh: Agent Skill（SKILL.md + scripts）
projects.caveat_zh: 这是 leo-lilinxiao 的 Skill，别与 TheGreenCedar 同名仓库混淆；保留／回退循环不是优化器自身递归进化。

projects.summary_zh: 智塔 FAROS：蓝图驱动的 AutoResearch 运行时 / AI 科学家系统
projects.summary_en: FAROS provides a blueprint-oriented research runtime coordinating agents, human collaboration and evidence auditing from topic selection to manuscript writing. The workbook describes front-end and back-end implementation, with process organization rather than explicit proof that its own research strategy improves recursively.
projects.target_zh: 选题到论文写作全流程
projects.mechanism_zh: 多智能体协作 + 人机协同 + 证据审计
projects.implementation_zh: 完整前后端工程
projects.caveat_zh: 蓝图、协作与审计属于研究过程控制；人机协同应保留，不能把审计视为研究有效性或递归能力保证。

projects.summary_zh: 面向物理 / 具身智能体的递归自我改进基础设施
projects.summary_en: PhyAgentOS connects cognitive planning, physical execution and task verification in an improvement loop over skills and execution strategies. The workbook describes implementation and deployment components for embodied agents, but does not specify a universal robot safety or transfer guarantee.
projects.mechanism_zh: 认知规划、物理执行与任务验证闭环
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 工程 + Docker
projects.caveat_zh: 具身基础设施与任务验证不自动证明真实机器人安全或迁移成功；原行未展开具体实验条件。

projects.summary_zh: 自指式自我改进智能体，可针对任意可计算任务优化
projects.summary_en: HyperAgents combines task agents with a meta-agent that edits candidate agent code and can also revise its own improvement process. An open archive supports parent selection; the workbook identifies implementation and container components but not independent replication.
projects.target_zh: 任务 Agent 及负责改进的 Meta Agent 自身
projects.mechanism_zh: Meta Agent 修改 Agent 代码（含自身的改进流程），开放式档案选择父代
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程（generate_loop、meta_agent、Docker）
projects.caveat_zh: 修改范围包括改进流程，是较强自指主张，但不应把“任意可计算任务”写成已证明的普遍能力。

projects.summary_zh: 形式化验证 + “无法作弊”的递归自我改进（Lean 4 / Dafny）
projects.summary_en: Formal Verification RSI combines coding-agent experiments with Lean and Dafny proof checking to detect invalid proof attempts and reward exploitation. The workbook describes benchmarks and run records; verification applies to encoded properties rather than establishing universally uncheatable recursive improvement.
projects.target_zh: 编码智能体（经验证的 RSI）
projects.mechanism_zh: Lean 4 + Dafny 证明检查器识别伪证明（奖励黑客）
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程 + 基准 + 运行记录
projects.caveat_zh: “无法作弊”是过强来源表述；证明检查只约束编码规范与检查器边界，不保证全面安全或无限递归。

projects.summary_zh: SkillClaw：让技能在多会话、多智能体、多用户间集体进化
projects.summary_en: SkillClaw uses an evolving-agent service to revise skills from real interactions and share experience across sessions, agents and users. The workbook describes client and server components; collective asset reuse is the mechanism, not demonstrated universal capability compounding.
projects.mechanism_zh: Agentic Evolver 从每次真实交互中进化技能，经验跨设备复利
projects.implementation_zh: Python 客户端 + 进化服务器
projects.attribution_zh: 阿里巴巴 高德 AMAP-ML
projects.caveat_zh: 跨用户技能共享须考虑适用性、误迁移和权限；“复利”是来源定位，不能作为持续收益证明。

projects.summary_zh: Memento：不微调 LLM 也能“微调”智能体的记忆式持续学习框架
projects.summary_en: Memento combines planning and execution with case-based reasoning over a retained case bank and external tools. The workbook explicitly frames it as improving agent behavior without fine-tuning the underlying language model, using remembered cases rather than mandatory neural-weight updates.
projects.mechanism_zh: 规划-执行架构 + 基于案例推理的记忆增强学习 + MCP 工具
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 工程（client / server / memory）
projects.caveat_zh: “不微调也能微调”是行为适应类比；Case Bank 更新不是 LLM 参数训练，也不保证任务外泛化。

projects.summary_zh: 达尔文哥德尔机（DGM）：开放式进化的自我改进编码智能体
projects.summary_en: DGM evolves the source code of a coding agent, evaluates candidate self-edits on software tasks and retains an open archive of agents. Its Darwinian selection relies on empirical benchmark feedback, not formal proofs that every modification is globally beneficial.
projects.target_zh: 编码智能体自身源代码
projects.mechanism_zh: 迭代修改自身代码并在 SWE-bench / Polyglot 上实证验证，维护开放式智能体档案
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 工程（DGM_outer.py、Docker 沙箱）
projects.attribution_zh: UBC / Sakana AI（Jeff Clune 团队）
projects.caveat_zh: 达尔文式实证筛选不等于哥德尔机形式证明；自身源码演化与固定外层档案搜索应分别说明。

projects.summary_zh: SIA 自我改进 AI 框架：Meta / Target / Feedback 多智能体代际循环，同时更新 harness 与权重
projects.summary_en: SIA separates meta, target and feedback agents in a generational loop that revises the target system. Unlike a strictly frozen-model harness optimizer, the workbook explicitly describes both harness changes and model-weight updates, with packaged task examples and visualization.
projects.target_zh: 目标智能体的 harness 与模型权重
projects.mechanism_zh: Meta Agent 依据反馈逐代改进 Target Agent；论文报告 LawBench +56.6%、GPU 内核运行时间 −91.9%
projects.implementation_zh: pip 可安装（sia-agent），内置 4 个任务与运行可视化
projects.caveat_zh: 虽然列入 Harness 类，原行明确同时更新权重；不能统一标成冻结模型，论文效果数字也不是本次复现实验。

projects.summary_zh: 自适应语言模型 SEAL：模型生成“自我编辑”来更新自身权重
projects.summary_en: SEAL trains a language model to produce self-edits consisting of fine-tuning data and update instructions. Those edits support knowledge incorporation and few-shot adaptation; the workbook describes reinforcement learning around this update-generating behavior, with separate experimental code and data.
projects.mechanism_zh: RL 训练模型生成微调数据与更新指令（self-edits），用于知识整合与少样本适应
projects.implementation_zh: Python 代码 + 数据（general-knowledge / few-shot）
projects.caveat_zh: self-edit 在此指用于权重更新的数据及指令，不是一般源码热修改；权重适应不等于普遍持续学习已成立。

projects.summary_zh: 绝对零（AZR）：零数据强化自博弈推理
projects.summary_en: Absolute Zero Reasoner uses one model to propose and solve tasks, with a code executor supplying verifiable feedback for reinforcement learning. The workbook describes an upstream-based training implementation whose synthetic task loop differs from a supervision-free starting point.
projects.mechanism_zh: 同一模型自提任务、自解任务，以代码执行器验证奖励
projects.implementation_zh: 完整训练与评估代码（基于 veRL）
projects.caveat_zh: “零数据”不等于没有预训练、执行器或奖励设计；依赖 veRL 的训练路线不能写成冻结权重 Harness 优化。

projects.summary_zh: MLE-bench：评估 AI 智能体的机器学习工程能力
projects.summary_en: MLE-bench supplies machine-learning engineering tasks, dataset preparation and scoring around Kaggle-style competition performance. The workbook describes baseline agent code as well as evaluation infrastructure; it measures submitted systems rather than demonstrating that those systems recursively improve their own learning machinery.
projects.target_zh: 评测：ML 工程 / AI 研发能力
projects.mechanism_zh: Kaggle 竞赛任务 + 奖牌制评分
projects.implementation_zh: 数据集构建、评分逻辑与基线智能体代码
projects.caveat_zh: 机器学习工程得分是任务能力证据，不自动是 RSI 证据；基准本身也不是自改进 Agent。

projects.summary_zh: 正则化递归自我改进（RRSI）：在开放编辑空间中进化 Agent harness 并抑制过拟合
projects.summary_en: RRSI searches an open harness-editing space while regularizing proposal and selection decisions. The workbook describes shrinking edit budgets, history-aware proposals, leakage screening, noise-aware acceptance and diversity controls across coding, workspace and engineering examples.
projects.target_zh: Agent harness（提示、控制流、工具、记忆、上下文管理）
projects.mechanism_zh: 退火编辑预算、全历史条件提议、Critic 泄漏筛查、噪声带选择、新颖性与剪枝
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 包 + coding / workspace / engineering 三类实例与测试
projects.caveat_zh: 这些控制针对过拟合与选择偏差，不保证泛化或安全；工作簿描述不能替代本次独立代码验证。

projects.summary_zh: 智能体系统自动设计（ADAS），提出 Meta Agent Search
projects.summary_en: ADAS uses a meta-agent to write candidate agent-system implementations, evaluate them on task suites and retain discoveries in an archive. The changing object is the generated agent design; the workbook does not establish that the outer searcher rewrites itself.
projects.target_zh: 以代码表示的智能体系统设计
projects.mechanism_zh: Meta Agent 基于历史发现迭代编写新 Agent 代码，评估后归档
projects.implementation_zh: Python 脚本，覆盖 ARC、DROP、MGSM、MMLU、GPQA 等领域
projects.caveat_zh: 任务智能体设计由外层搜索器生成；候选源码变化不等于 Meta Agent Search 自身递归进化。

projects.summary_zh: Meta-Harness：对固定基座模型的任务专属 harness 做端到端自动搜索
projects.summary_en: Meta-Harness searches task-specific execution code for a fixed base model. A proposing coding agent reads previous candidates and logs, writes a new harness and receives evaluation feedback; the workbook identifies classification and terminal-task reference experiments.
projects.target_zh: Harness 代码（存储、检索、展示给模型的信息）
projects.mechanism_zh: Proposer Agent（默认 Claude Code）读取历史候选与日志提出新 harness 并迭代评估
projects.implementation_zh: 框架 + 文本分类与 Terminal-Bench 2.0 两个参考实验，附 ONBOARDING 引导
projects.caveat_zh: 搜索任务专属 Harness 不自动等于搜索器自改进；外部编码 Agent 的能力与候选 Harness 的效果应分开。

projects.summary_zh: 完全递归的 agent + harness 架构，可在运行时安全修改自身各部分
projects.summary_en: Exo supplies a runtime architecture in which agents and harness components can be modified during operation. The workbook describes persistent sessions and sandbox, credential and network controls, alongside a mixed-language implementation whose documentation remains under development.
projects.target_zh: 智能体及其 harness 的全部组成
projects.mechanism_zh: 运行时自我修改 + 安全学习架构（沙箱、凭据与网络控制、持久会话）
projects.implementation_zh: Rust + TypeScript 工程（crates、eval/harbor、fuzz）；文档仍在完善
projects.reference_zh: Exo: An Architecture for Self-Improving Systems at Runtime（2026 预印本）
projects.caveat_zh: 运行时可改写与控制机制不等于所有修改均安全或有效；“完全递归”属于来源定位，文档仍在完善。

projects.summary_zh: LLM 驱动的自进化量化 Alpha 因子挖掘框架
projects.summary_en: QuantaAlpha evolves quantitative factor hypotheses and their implementations, combining diverse initial plans with trajectory-level search and constraints linking ideas to code. The workbook describes a research package and interface, not validated investment performance or recursively improving foundation models.
projects.mechanism_zh: 多样化规划初始化 + 轨迹级进化 + 结构化假设-代码约束
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + 前端 UI
projects.caveat_zh: 因子回测或搜索结果不等于真实投资收益；假设–代码约束也不能消除数据泄漏，许可证为未声明。

projects.summary_zh: AgentEvolver：高效自进化智能体系统的端到端训练框架
projects.summary_en: AgentEvolver trains agent policies through generated tasks, experience-assisted exploration and fine-grained reward attribution. The workbook describes a complete training framework with environment services and game settings, placing weight learning at the center rather than only collecting reusable memory.
projects.mechanism_zh: 自我提问（任务生成）+ 自我导航（经验复用探索）+ 自我归因（细粒度奖励）
projects.implementation_zh: 完整训练框架 + 环境服务 + 游戏竞技场
projects.caveat_zh: 任务自生成、经验复用及奖励归因服务于参数训练；环境和奖励设计仍是外部条件，不证明改进器自进化。

projects.summary_zh: GPU 内核版 autoresearch：自动优化 Triton / CUDA 内核
projects.summary_en: Autokernel applies an experiment loop to GPU kernels: profile bottlenecks, isolate a kernel, propose Triton or CUDA changes, benchmark them and retain or revert candidates. The workbook describes software including kernel tasks, targeting execution code rather than researcher-model parameters.
projects.mechanism_zh: 剖析瓶颈 → 抽取内核 → 智能体修改 → 基准评估 → 保留/回退
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程（含 KernelBench）
projects.caveat_zh: 内核性能提升需同时保持正确性及硬件公平；固定实验外层不等于研究 Agent 权重或改进算法自进化。

projects.summary_zh: AIDE：机器学习工程智能体（MLE-bench 参考实现）
projects.summary_en: AIDE searches machine-learning code through drafting, debugging and benchmark evaluation, using a tree of candidate experiments to pursue better metrics. The workbook describes a packaged research agent and reference role in MLE-bench, not evidence that AIDE itself recursively rewrites its optimizer.
projects.mechanism_zh: 树搜索：起草、调试、基准测试，直至指标最优
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + CLI + 可视化
projects.caveat_zh: ML 工程树搜索针对实验代码；MLE-bench 参考实现身份不是独立复现或科研者递归能力证明。

projects.summary_zh: 开放式、样本高效的程序进化框架
projects.summary_en: ShinkaEvolve maintains a population of scientific programs and uses multiple language models to propose mutations. Novelty filtering and adaptive proposer selection aim to spend evaluations efficiently; the workbook describes a reusable program-evolution package, not necessarily an evolving outer optimizer.
projects.mechanism_zh: LLM 集成作为变异算子，维护程序种群，新颖性筛选与自适应模型选择
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 包 + 文档 + 示例
projects.caveat_zh: 自适应选择模型不等于更新模型权重或改写进化器；样本效率与开放式发现仍需任务内证据。

projects.summary_zh: 把任意代码库变成 autoresearch 循环的插件
projects.summary_en: Evo wraps an existing codebase in an optimization loop that identifies metrics, evaluates tree-searched experiments and retains improvements. The workbook describes a plugin and SDK, making metric-driven code search the mechanism rather than necessarily changing the host model or outer optimizer.
projects.mechanism_zh: 自动发现指标与评估 → 树搜索实验 → 保留改进
projects.implementation_zh: 插件 + SDK
projects.caveat_zh: 自动发现指标也需确认指标有效；插件依赖宿主，代码收益不等于模型或搜索器自身提高，活跃度未知。

projects.summary_zh: Self-Rewarding LM 训练框架的 PyTorch 实现（附 SPIN）
projects.summary_en: This community PyTorch library implements self-rewarding language-model training by turning model-scored responses into preference pairs for iterative DPO. The workbook also mentions SPIN support; it is a downstream implementation, not independent confirmation of the original method's reported results.
projects.mechanism_zh: 模型自评打分构造偏好对 → 迭代 DPO
projects.implementation_zh: pip 可安装的 PyTorch 库
projects.caveat_zh: 必须标明社区实现；自评奖励可能偏离真实质量，不能把库存在或迭代 DPO 当作已复现效果。

projects.summary_zh: rStar 系列：rStar-Math 自我进化深度思考；主线为 rStar2-Agent 智能体 RL
projects.summary_en: The rStar repository spans agent reinforcement learning and a separate mathematical reasoning branch. The workbook attributes iterative policy and process-reward-model training with search-generated trajectories to rStar-Math, while identifying rStar2-Agent as the main implementation line.
projects.target_zh: 策略模型与过程奖励模型权重
projects.mechanism_zh: MCTS 生成可验证轨迹，多轮自我进化训练策略 SLM 与 PPM（rStar-Math 分支）
projects.implementation_zh: 完整训练代码（主分支 rStar2-Agent，rStar-Math 在独立分支）
projects.caveat_zh: rStar-Math 机制对应独立分支，不能套到主分支所有代码；策略模型和奖励模型权重变化需分开。

projects.summary_zh: 智能体上下文工程 ACE：把上下文当作不断演化的 playbook
projects.summary_en: ACE treats agent context as an incrementally revised playbook, separating generation, reflection and curation roles. The workbook emphasizes preserving useful detail while avoiding overcompression, with framework and evaluation materials supporting context adaptation instead of mandatory model fine-tuning.
projects.mechanism_zh: 生成 – 反思 – 策展三角色增量更新，避免简略偏置与上下文坍缩
projects.implementation_zh: Python 框架 + 评估 + 教程
projects.caveat_zh: 上下文手册持续修订不同于权重更新；避免坍缩是设计目标，不保证经验永远正确或可迁移。

projects.summary_zh: 递归自我改进 harness：围绕目标反复运行与评估，保留经验并为后续迭代产出资产
projects.summary_en: Autocontext repeatedly runs and evaluates goal-directed attempts, retaining useful experience and discarding unsuccessful paths. Its outputs include contextual playbooks, trajectories, reports and training data; the workbook also mentions optional local-model training beyond ordinary harness-level adaptation.
projects.target_zh: 上下文、playbook、数据集（可选本地模型训练）
projects.mechanism_zh: 运行 → 评估 → 保留有效经验 / 丢弃死路 → 产出轨迹、报告、playbook 与训练数据
projects.implementation_zh: Python CLI/库 + TypeScript CLI（uv / bun 安装）
projects.caveat_zh: 主要是上下文与经验资产循环，但存在可选本地训练；不能因所属类别把所有路径写成权重冻结。

projects.summary_zh: Agent0 系列：零数据自进化智能体（含 Agent0-VL）
projects.summary_en: Agent0 couples a curriculum agent with an execution agent so generated challenges and tool-using reasoning evolve together through training. The workbook covers both Agent0 and its vision-language variant, describing model-weight learning rather than merely runtime prompt refinement.
projects.mechanism_zh: 课程 Agent 与执行 Agent 协同进化，工具集成推理
projects.implementation_zh: Agent0 与 Agent0-VL 训练代码
projects.caveat_zh: “零数据”不能抹去预训练、工具与奖励依赖；Agent0 和 Agent0-VL 为同一仓库系列，不另造重复项目。

projects.summary_zh: 自博弈微调 SPIN：把弱模型变强
projects.summary_en: SPIN iteratively fine-tunes a model against its previous outputs, using distinctions between human-provided examples and generated responses. The workbook describes training scripts and configurations; its self-play framing does not remove the role of the original human data.
projects.mechanism_zh: 模型与上一迭代的自身对弈，区分人类数据与自生成数据
projects.implementation_zh: Python 训练脚本 + 配置
projects.caveat_zh: 自博弈仍以人类数据作参照；重复训练不是训练算法自身递归变更的证据。

projects.summary_zh: 端到端自主 AI 科研引擎（含 Evo 自进化流水线）
projects.summary_en: NanoResearch manages a research pipeline from ideas to manuscripts, submitting GPU experiments and collecting their outputs within an evolution-oriented workflow. The workbook describes a full application with tool-server and messaging integrations, but does not specify every retained self-improvement state.
projects.mechanism_zh: 真实提交 GPU 实验并收集结果 + 自进化流水线
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 工程 + MCP + 飞书机器人
projects.caveat_zh: 来源强调真实 GPU 实验，但本次未运行；Evo 流水线的实际自改进边界未展开，不能补写权重训练。

projects.summary_zh: 前沿能力评测集（含 PaperBench 论文复现）
projects.summary_en: Frontier Evals collects evaluation implementations including PaperBench, where agents reproduce research papers and are scored against specified requirements. The workbook describes multiple managed projects, making paper-replication competence the assessment target rather than necessarily measuring an evolving improver.
projects.target_zh: 评测：AI 研究复现能力
projects.mechanism_zh: 端到端复现前沿 AI 论文并按评分细则打分
projects.implementation_zh: 多个评测项目（uv 管理）
projects.caveat_zh: 论文复现能力与改进器自身递归改进不同；集合中的评测不能统一解读成一个 RSI 机制。

projects.summary_zh: “优化一切”的自动进化框架：可调对象抽象为文件目录，由 Agent 迭代优化
projects.summary_en: AntOmniEvo treats editable files or directories as optimization artifacts, ranging from skills and workflows to algorithms. A framework-controlled loop delegates changes to an agent and scores them against user-defined criteria, with visualization and packaged examples.
projects.target_zh: Skill、工作流、单文件算法等可调制品
projects.mechanism_zh: 用户定义可调制品与评估标准，框架控制循环，Agent 作为提议者编辑文件
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 包 + skills + 可视化器
projects.caveat_zh: 用户定义目标、框架控制外层循环；“优化一切”不是无限通用能力，也不证明外层优化器会改写自身。

projects.summary_zh: 基于世界模型的通用递归自我改进框架
projects.summary_en: RSI-Anything uses a JEPA-style world model to predict candidate outcomes, guide selection and learn from external evaluation. The workbook applies this decision loop to code repairs, interface interactions and experiment planning, with task configurations and tests.
projects.target_zh: 决策与候选方案选择（代码修复、GUI 交互、实验规划等）
projects.mechanism_zh: JEPA 世界模型预测 → 预测引导筛选 → 外部评估 → 学习，闭环改进下一次决策
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 src/rsi_anything + 配置、任务与测试
projects.caveat_zh: 原行没有澄清“学习”是否实际更新神经权重；世界模型预测和外部评估不能自动推导普遍递归能力。

projects.summary_zh: 图结构 LLM 智能体框架，支持智能体群自组织与自我改进
projects.summary_en: GPTSwarm expresses collaborating language agents as an optimizable computation graph. Prompt optimization and reinforcement-learning procedures revise node behavior and connections, making communication structure part of the search space; the workbook describes a package and experimental notebooks.
projects.target_zh: 智能体图（节点提示与连接拓扑）
projects.mechanism_zh: 把智能体建模为可优化计算图，用 RL / 提示优化自动改进节点与边
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包（swarm）+ 实验与 notebooks
projects.caveat_zh: 图连接或提示优化应与基座模型权重训练区分；RL 在此描述优化机制，不足以证明 LLM 参数更新。

projects.summary_zh: 测试时强化学习 TTRL：在无标签测试数据上自我进化
projects.summary_en: TTRL adapts model weights during testing by estimating reinforcement-learning rewards from majority agreement on unlabeled test inputs. The workbook describes a veRL-based implementation; the critical distinction is parameter adaptation with estimated feedback rather than contextual memory alone.
projects.mechanism_zh: 多数投票估计奖励，在测试数据上进行 RL
projects.implementation_zh: 基于 veRL 的实现
projects.caveat_zh: 多数投票是奖励估计而不是真值，可能强化一致性错误；测试时参数更新应与仅上下文学习严格区分。

projects.summary_zh: 面向数据智能体的自进化本体层
projects.summary_en: EvoOntology constructs a versioned semantic layer over tables, files and databases from workload evidence, then adapts that ontology using execution traces. The workbook describes a package and tool-server integration, focusing on data interpretation assets rather than model-weight evolution.
projects.target_zh: 本体层（表、文件、数据库语义）
projects.mechanism_zh: 基于真实负载证据构建版本化本体，并从执行轨迹持续适配
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + MCP 插件
projects.caveat_zh: 本体版本变化不等于模型权重或推理核心变强；负载证据驱动的适配需要防止错误语义沉淀。

projects.summary_zh: 由自主编码智能体驱动的开源 autoresearch
projects.summary_en: CORAL coordinates coding agents that run experiments, share knowledge and refine solution code using scores. The workbook describes a research implementation with deployment and plugin support; collective experimentation is the stated mechanism, not a demonstrated universally improving research policy.
projects.target_zh: 解决方案代码与共享知识
projects.mechanism_zh: 多智能体自进化：运行实验、共享知识、评分驱动持续改进
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 工程 + 插件 + Docker
projects.caveat_zh: 评分驱动代码与知识更新不等于改进器自递归；多智能体共享不保证新颖性、质量或无奖励利用。

projects.summary_zh: 通用自主科研智能体：生长假设树并只保留经留出数据验证的收益
projects.summary_en: Arbor grows a tree of research hypotheses, modifies benchmark code and runs experiments, retaining gains that survive held-out evaluation. The workbook describes an installable agent; its validation boundary is stronger than self-scoring but still limited to the selected tasks and protocol.
projects.mechanism_zh: 提出假设 → 改代码 → 真实实验 → 保留留出集上成立的收益
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包（pip install arbor-agent）
projects.caveat_zh: 留出验证有助约束过拟合，不能保证科学新颖性或普遍泛化；优化基准代码也不等于改进研究者本身。

projects.summary_zh: 构建受监督、自我进化的 Agent 组织的基础设施
projects.summary_en: Metabot supplies supervised agent-organization infrastructure with shared memory, scheduled work and a communication bus around coding-agent hosts. The workbook describes an agent factory and messaging integrations, but provides fewer details of evaluated improvement than of orchestration and persistence.
projects.target_zh: Agent 组织的共享记忆与 Agent 工厂
projects.mechanism_zh: 在飞书 / Telegram 运行 Claude Code / Kimi Code，共享记忆、定时任务、通信总线
projects.implementation_zh: 完整工程（MIT）
projects.caveat_zh: 原行更明确的是组织编排与共享记忆；自进化闭环细节不足，不应补写自动评估或保证自主递归。

projects.summary_zh: AI4Science 智能体的可验证程序级自进化
projects.summary_en: ScienceClaw updates persistent skill-and-operator programs from execution evidence checked through replay. The workbook describes typed operators within a scientific-agent application, focusing on reusable program-level changes rather than simply generated prose or assumed training of the base model.
projects.mechanism_zh: 从回放验证的执行证据中更新持久 Skill–Operator 程序
projects.implementation_zh: 完整工程（TypeScript / Python）
projects.caveat_zh: 回放验证只覆盖所测执行条件，不是全面形式证明；程序级技能更新应与权重训练区分。

projects.summary_zh: Agentic Harness Engineering：可观测性驱动的编码 Agent harness 自动进化
projects.summary_en: Agentic Harness Engineering uses observable execution traces to revise prompts, tool descriptions and implementations, middleware, skills, subagents and memory. The workbook describes a fixed base model and retained harness artifacts, with an evaluation-oriented implementation and configurations.
projects.target_zh: 系统提示、工具描述与实现、中间件、技能、子代理、长期记忆
projects.mechanism_zh: 基座模型固定，基于执行轨迹可观测性迭代进化 harness 组件（Terminal-Bench 2.0 84.7%）
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 工程（evolve.py、agents、configs、已进化 harness）
projects.caveat_zh: 来源中的 Terminal-Bench 成绩不是本次验证；固定模型的外围改进也不等于模型自身学习。

projects.summary_zh: R-Zero：从零数据自我进化的推理 LLM
projects.summary_en: R-Zero co-trains a challenger that generates questions and a solver that answers them, using their interaction to drive reasoning-model updates. The workbook describes training and evaluation atop veRL, not learning from an absence of initialization or reward assumptions.
projects.mechanism_zh: Challenger 出题、Solver 解题，两者协同进化
projects.implementation_zh: 基于 veRL 的训练与评估代码
projects.caveat_zh: “从零数据”是任务数据定位，不代表无预训练或无监督机制；许可证原行未声明。

projects.summary_zh: 自我改进智能体的通用基础设施：输入基础 Agent，自动进化出更强 Agent
projects.summary_en: A-Evolve provides an optimization workspace for an existing agent, including prompts, tools and skills. Pluggable evolutionary procedures run against benchmarks to generate successors; the workbook lists seed workspaces and examples as infrastructure rather than a universal improvement guarantee.
projects.target_zh: Agent 工作区（提示、技能、工具等 harness）
projects.mechanism_zh: 可插拔进化算法 + 基准驱动循环（3 行代码启动）
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 agent_evolve + seed workspaces + 示例
projects.caveat_zh: “更强 Agent”须受评估任务和预算限定；外层算法可插拔不表示会自改写，许可证原值为未声明。

projects.summary_zh: 在代码库内运行优化循环的 Codex 插件
projects.summary_en: This Codex plugin records a codebase baseline, evaluates small performance or resource changes and produces patches with supporting evidence. The workbook describes a host-dependent optimization layer, not a standalone scientist or proof that the patch-generating agent recursively improves itself.
projects.mechanism_zh: 记录基线 → 评估小改动 → 产出带证据的补丁
projects.implementation_zh: Codex 插件
projects.caveat_zh: 这是 TheGreenCedar 的插件，勿与 leo-lilinxiao 同名 Skill 混同；证据补丁仍需评估协议，技术栈原行未识别。

projects.summary_zh: LLM4AD：大模型驱动的自动算法设计平台
projects.summary_en: LLM4AD integrates several language-model-driven algorithm design methods with benchmark problems and a graphical interface. It serves as a common platform for searching heuristics and algorithms, while the included search procedures remain distinct from evidence of self-modifying researchers.
projects.mechanism_zh: 集成 EoH、FunSearch、ReEvo 等多种 LLM 搜索方法与基准任务
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + GUI + 文档
projects.attribution_zh: 香港城市大学 Optima 团队
projects.caveat_zh: 平台集成 EoH、FunSearch、ReEvo 不代表统一递归机制；算法搜索与改进器自修改要分开。

projects.summary_zh: AutoScientists：自组织智能体团队进行长时科学实验
projects.summary_en: AutoScientists uses decentralized agent teams to organize around hypotheses, review proposed experiments and share successful or unsuccessful experience during long-running research. The workbook describes a system and several task settings, without establishing independent scientific discovery or recursively improving team policies.
projects.mechanism_zh: 去中心化团队围绕假设自组织、互评提案、共享成败经验
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程（system + 3 类任务）
projects.caveat_zh: 自组织与互评是协作机制，不自动证明科学发现成立或团队策略递归提高；许可证原行未声明。

projects.summary_zh: Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode 自我改进插件：把交互沉淀为持久技能
projects.summary_en: Claude Smart captures user corrections and successful execution paths as persistent project or shared skills and preferences. The workbook describes a plugin with dashboards and benchmarks across coding-agent hosts, making host-dependent behavioral adaptation the retained mechanism.
projects.target_zh: 项目级与共享技能、偏好
projects.mechanism_zh: 从用户纠正与成功路径中学习
projects.implementation_zh: 插件工程 + 仪表盘 + 基准
projects.caveat_zh: 宿主插件从交互学习，不等于宿主模型权重更新；共享技能仍需作用域、隐私和质量约束。

projects.summary_zh: OPRO：大语言模型作为优化器
projects.summary_en: OPRO places earlier candidate solutions and scores into a meta-prompt so a language model can propose new candidates. The workbook covers prompts and mathematical optimization examples; the proposal loop need not alter either model weights or the outer optimization instructions.
projects.mechanism_zh: 把历史解与得分写入元提示，迭代生成更优解
projects.implementation_zh: Python 代码
projects.caveat_zh: 历史解与分数驱动搜索不等于模型自训练；固定元提示的外层也不必递归变化。

projects.summary_zh: Trace：面向 AI 智能体的端到端生成式优化
projects.summary_en: Trace records an agent's execution as a computation graph and uses an OptoPrime optimizer to revise code, prompts or exposed parameters from general feedback. The workbook describes a library and examples, with generative optimization distinct from assuming neural backpropagation.
projects.target_zh: 智能体代码、提示与参数
projects.mechanism_zh: 类 AutoDiff 的执行图追踪 + OptoPrime 优化器，利用一般反馈端到端更新
projects.implementation_zh: Python 库 opto + 示例
projects.caveat_zh: “参数”涵盖可优化程序变量，不能直接推断基座模型权重训练；执行图追踪不等于改进器自修改。

projects.summary_zh: 大模型进化（ELM）开源库：在代码与自然语言上做进化搜索
projects.summary_en: OpenELM supplies evolutionary search over code and natural-language artifacts, using language models as mutation or difference generators. Quality-diversity methods maintain varied candidates across example environments; the workbook describes a library rather than automatic neural-weight learning.
projects.mechanism_zh: LLM 作为变异/差分模型，结合 MAP-Elites 等质量-多样性算法
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + 环境示例
projects.caveat_zh: 进化的是代码或文本候选，不必是 LLM 权重；多样性档案的增长不能单独证明通用能力提高。

projects.summary_zh: Quiet-STaR：语言模型自学“先思考再说话”
projects.summary_en: Quiet-STaR trains a model to generate internal reasoning around token prediction and reinforce thoughts that help subsequent output. The workbook describes a model-specific Transformers modification and training scripts, rather than an agent that recursively rewrites its own reasoning implementation.
projects.mechanism_zh: 为每个 token 生成内部理由并强化学习有用的思考
projects.implementation_zh: 基于 Transformers 的 Mistral 补丁 + 训练脚本
projects.caveat_zh: 这是特定模型补丁与参数训练；内部理由的奖励学习不等于自修改推理引擎或推理正确性保证。

projects.summary_zh: 下一代自动算法设计平台（OpenLoopX）：一条命令从问题描述到进化搜索
projects.summary_en: LLM4AD Next, described as OpenLoopX, connects problem descriptions to language-model-driven algorithm evolution. Its workbook entry includes container and skill integration and optional connection to a research workflow, without establishing that the search engine recursively rewrites itself.
projects.mechanism_zh: LLM 驱动进化优化，可接入 AutoResearchClaw 研究流程
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程 + Docker + skills
projects.attribution_zh: 香港城市大学 Optima 团队
projects.caveat_zh: 命令入口及科研流程联动是集成功能；不要将 Next／OpenLoopX 另造为独立已验证项目或保证发现成功。

projects.summary_zh: 自主自进化电脑操作智能体：视觉落地的分层记忆与自写技能
projects.summary_en: Photo Agents combines perception, reasoning and action with hierarchical memory and agent-written skills for computer use. The workbook describes a Python implementation, with retained skills as the adaptation mechanism rather than explicit evidence of weight training or self-optimizer revision.
projects.mechanism_zh: 感知 – 推理 – 行动框架，智能体自写技能
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程
projects.caveat_zh: 自写电脑操作技能不证明核心推理器自改写；视觉落地和层级记忆也不保证 GUI 任务安全与泛化。

projects.summary_zh: ReasoningBank：以推理记忆扩展智能体自进化
projects.summary_en: ReasoningBank extracts strategy-level memories from successful and unsuccessful trajectories and reuses them through memory-aware test-time expansion. The workbook lists web and software-task code; improvement is mediated by retained reasoning experience rather than necessarily changing the base model's parameters.
projects.mechanism_zh: 从成功与失败轨迹中提炼推理记忆 + 记忆感知的测试时扩展
projects.implementation_zh: Python 代码（WebArena、SWE-Bench）
projects.caveat_zh: 策略级记忆与测试时扩展不是权重更新；成功／失败经验抽取仍需有效筛选，不能保证跨任务正确。

projects.summary_zh: AFlow：自动生成与优化 Agentic 工作流
projects.summary_en: AFlow searches executable representations of agent workflows using Monte Carlo tree search. Candidate control structures are evaluated and iteratively refined in a benchmark workspace; this changes the workflow while leaving the stated outer search procedure conceptually distinct.
projects.mechanism_zh: 在代码化工作流空间中用蒙特卡洛树搜索迭代改进
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程（run.py、benchmarks、workspace）
projects.caveat_zh: 这是代码化工作流搜索；固定 MCTS 外层不应被包装成改进器自身的递归优化。

projects.summary_zh: MemSkill：学习并进化记忆技能的自进化智能体
projects.summary_en: MemSkill learns, refines and reuses procedures for constructing memory, treating memory operations themselves as skills. The workbook describes a data-driven loop and evaluation scripts; this targets how experience is stored rather than establishing an unrestricted self-modifying model.
projects.mechanism_zh: 数据驱动循环：学习、精炼并复用记忆操作技能
projects.implementation_zh: Python 代码 + 评估脚本
projects.caveat_zh: “学习”未在该行澄清是否训练模型参数；应写为记忆操作技能优化，不擅自补成冻结权重或 RL。

projects.summary_zh: 自博弈偏好优化 SPPO
projects.summary_en: SPPO frames preference alignment as a two-player constant-sum game and applies iterative policy updates toward an equilibrium objective. The workbook describes training scripts and released models; the optimized object is the policy, not necessarily the preference evaluator or training procedure.
projects.mechanism_zh: 把对齐视为两人常和博弈，迭代逼近纳什均衡
projects.implementation_zh: 训练脚本 + 发布模型
projects.caveat_zh: 纳什均衡是优化目标与分析框架，不代表任意实际训练已收敛；模型发布不等于本次验证。

projects.summary_zh: 以个人模型为先的自进化 AI 智能体
projects.summary_en: Elephant Agent prioritizes a persistent representation of its user, retaining memories and reusable work paths to personalize later interactions. The workbook describes a complete application but gives limited detail about measured improvement, training or how candidate behavioral changes are validated.
projects.target_zh: 个人模型、记忆与工作路径
projects.mechanism_zh: 持续理解用户并塑造可复用路径
projects.implementation_zh: 完整工程
projects.caveat_zh: 个人模型指用户理解，未必是独立神经模型；验证机制未展开，许可证未声明，不应补写训练或递归保证。

projects.summary_zh: 免训练多智能体框架：在新数字环境中先广后深探索并递归自我改进
projects.summary_en: RSI Agent coordinates curriculum, execution and verification agents to explore unfamiliar digital environments, retaining validated experience as reusable memory. The workbook explicitly describes a training-free approach with desktop and game environment runners, not test-time parameter learning.
projects.mechanism_zh: 课程 / 执行 / 验证三智能体，验证后的经验写入记忆
projects.implementation_zh: 完整 Python 工程（OSWorld / ALE 运行脚本）
projects.caveat_zh: 免训练机制靠验证后记忆沉淀；数字环境探索不等于权重学习，也不保证所有新环境有效。

projects.summary_zh: 完全可复现、零起点的原位自进化智能体系统
projects.summary_en: Yunjue Agent develops tools, skills and experience while working through open-ended tasks, retaining changes in the active agent setting. The workbook describes code, a demonstration interface and a report, but its reproducibility and zero-start language remains a source claim.
projects.mechanism_zh: 在开放式任务中原位自我进化
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程 + Web Demo + 技术报告
projects.caveat_zh: “完全可复现”“零起点”是来源主张；本次没有运行工程，不能宣称已复现，也不能抹去基础模型依赖。

projects.summary_zh: WebRL：自进化在线课程强化学习训练网页智能体
projects.summary_en: WebRL trains web agents using a curriculum generated from failures, outcome-based reward modeling and adaptive reinforcement learning. The workbook describes training code with upstream components, so the improvement loop updates agent-model weights rather than only storing browser skills.
projects.mechanism_zh: 从失败中生成新任务的自进化课程 + 结果监督奖励模型 + 自适应 RL
projects.implementation_zh: Python 训练代码（含 LLaMA-Factory）
projects.caveat_zh: 网页环境中的课程与奖励设计是训练条件；不能只归为记忆技能积累，许可证原值未声明。

projects.summary_zh: 可审计的多智能体 AUTO Research 循环
projects.summary_en: AutoScholarLoop structures multiagent research into stages with quality audits across ideas, experiments and manuscripts. The workbook describes package, skill and web components; auditability supports traceable research but does not itself establish valid results or self-improvement of the auditing process.
projects.mechanism_zh: 分阶段研究循环 + 质量审计
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + Skills + Web
projects.caveat_zh: 质量审计不等于外部独立验证；研究产物与审计器自身改进应区分，许可为非标准／待看文件。

projects.summary_zh: 智能体工作流记忆 AWM：诱导并复用可重用工作流
projects.summary_en: Agent Workflow Memory derives reusable subprocedures from past task execution and stores them to guide later actions. The workbook describes offline and online variants in web-task pipelines, with workflow reuse serving as adaptation rather than changes to an outer learning algorithm.
projects.mechanism_zh: 从经验中诱导常用子流程并作为记忆指导后续任务（离线 / 在线）
projects.implementation_zh: WebArena 与 Mind2Web 流水线
projects.caveat_zh: 在线／离线经验诱导应分开；复用子流程不等于源码递归修改，也不保证新网站上仍正确。

projects.summary_zh: 首个运行时自进化软件工程智能体，在解决问题过程中即时扩展自身能力
projects.summary_en: Live SWE Agent uses upstream mini-swe-agent configurations and prompts to create or revise tools while solving software tasks. The workbook describes runtime capability extension, but the repository is a downstream configuration-based implementation rather than a standalone agent framework.
projects.target_zh: 智能体工具集与行为（运行时自建工具）
projects.mechanism_zh: 基于 mini-swe-agent，让 Agent 在线创建/修改工具；SWE-bench Verified 79.2%（Claude Opus 4.5）
projects.implementation_zh: 以 mini-swe-agent 配置与提示词实现，依赖上游框架运行
projects.caveat_zh: 依赖 mini-swe-agent 运行；临时自建工具不等于完整自改写引擎，来源的模型特定基准成绩不是本次验证。

projects.summary_zh: 赫胥黎-哥德尔机（HGM）：近似最优自我改进机的编码智能体
projects.summary_en: HGM evolves a coding agent's own implementation while choosing expansion opportunities using estimates of productivity across related candidate subtrees. The workbook describes software-task evaluation and containerized execution; its near-optimality framing should remain separate from demonstrated benchmark behavior.
projects.mechanism_zh: 用子树（clade）元生产力估计决定扩展哪些自我修改
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程（hgm.py、Docker、SWE-bench / Polyglot）
projects.caveat_zh: “近似最优”是方法定位，不应当作普遍理论保证；子树元生产力估计仍依赖任务与采样。

projects.summary_zh: “RSI 领域的 scikit-learn”：模块化递归 harness 进化框架
projects.summary_en: Gear offers modular contracts for refining agent instructions, tools and workflows through representative benchmark feedback. Its workbook description centers on a reusable refinement skill and mixed-language packages, with models also listed among configurable agent components.
projects.target_zh: Agent 的模型、指令、工具与工作流
projects.mechanism_zh: 在代表性任务基准上运行 Refine Skill，依据评估结果迭代改进
projects.implementation_zh: TypeScript 主体 + Python 子包，含 contracts、示例与测试
projects.caveat_zh: “模型”被列为对象但未明确是否更新权重；应区分模型选择、参数训练与 Harness 变更，不能直接推断冻结或训练。

projects.summary_zh: SICA：在自身代码库上工作的自我改进编码智能体
projects.summary_en: SICA applies a evaluate-and-archive loop to its own coding-agent repository, then implements proposed changes and repeats. The workbook describes a containerized benchmark setting, making the agent's implementation the editable artifact rather than merely generating unrelated solution code.
projects.mechanism_zh: 基准评估 → 归档 → 在自身代码上实施改进 → 循环
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程 + Docker 沙箱 + 基准数据
projects.caveat_zh: 自身代码库确属修改对象，但基准内改进不证明无限递归或任务外泛化；来源实现完整度未由本次运行确认。

projects.summary_zh: 递归中的递归自我改进：交互式科学智能体
projects.summary_en: ScienceBuddy describes an interactive research loop that improves analysis workflows with user collaboration and improves models in an outer loop. The workbook presents these two levels together, but does not fully specify the retained states or how outer model improvement is measured.
projects.mechanism_zh: 与用户协作中改进流程（内层）并改进模型（外层）
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包（uv）
projects.caveat_zh: 内层流程与外层模型改进须分别呈现；“递归中的递归”是来源主张，原行未充分澄清模型更新细节。

projects.summary_zh: 个人 AI“替身”：白天实时协作，夜间改写自身代码
projects.summary_en: Sutando combines a personal assistant's user-pattern learning with idle-time coding sessions that revise and publish its own code and skills. The workbook describes a local Mac application using external coding agents, not a formally verified autonomous self-improvement process.
projects.mechanism_zh: 学习用户模式，空闲时通过 Claude Code / Codex 会话编写并发布自身代码
projects.implementation_zh: 完整工程（src、skills、tests），Mac 本地运行
projects.caveat_zh: 外部 Claude Code／Codex 会话是实现依赖；个人模式学习和自动发布不能直接证明递归能力或发布安全。

projects.summary_zh: 让智能体自我改进的 harness：从真实用户交互中持续学习
projects.summary_en: Reflexio retains user corrections as durable behavioral preferences and captures successful paths for reuse by agents. The workbook describes service and client interfaces plus benchmarks; this is interaction-driven harness adaptation, not an independently established recursive model-learning process.
projects.target_zh: 行为偏好与成功执行路径
projects.mechanism_zh: 用户纠正 → 持久化行为改进；捕获成功路径以复用
projects.implementation_zh: Python SDK / CLI + TS 客户端 + 基准
projects.caveat_zh: 用户纠正是外部反馈；行为持久化不等于 LLM 自训练，成功路径复用也可能出现作用域错误。

projects.summary_zh: 启发式进化（EoH）：进化计算 + LLM 自动设计算法/启发式
projects.summary_en: EoH evolves a heuristic's conceptual description together with executable code, using language-model proposals inside an evolutionary computation loop. The workbook describes a package and examples aimed at algorithm design, with improvement judged on problem-specific evaluation.
projects.target_zh: 启发式算法（思想 + 代码）
projects.mechanism_zh: “思想”与代码协同进化
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 eoh + 示例
projects.caveat_zh: 思想与代码协同进化不等于进化算子自身变化；效果依赖问题与评估预算。

projects.summary_zh: MLAgentBench：评估语言智能体的机器学习实验能力
projects.summary_en: MLAgentBench provides executable environments for end-to-end machine-learning experiments by language agents. The workbook describes packaged evaluation code and runners; task completion and experimental performance assess research assistance, not automatically retained or recursive improvement of the evaluated agent.
projects.mechanism_zh: 端到端 ML 实验任务环境
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + 运行脚本
projects.caveat_zh: ML 实验能力不是递归自增强的充分证据；环境评测与被评测 Agent 的学习机制应分开。

projects.summary_zh: 基于文件的进化框架：在固定评估器下进行可复现、可控的智能体自我改进
projects.summary_en: RSIHub organizes candidate agents as files and evaluates them with a fixed evaluator. It records lineage and declared edit boundaries, then composes evolution recipes over prompts, scaffolds and skills to make candidate comparisons more traceable.
projects.target_zh: 候选智能体（提示、脚手架、技能等）
projects.mechanism_zh: 候选对固定评估器运行，记录血统，声明修改边界，组合式进化方法（recipes）
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 src/evolve + recipes / scaffolds / evals
projects.caveat_zh: 固定评估器、血统和边界记录支持可追踪实验，不等于已验证递归或全面可复现；外层 recipes 是否变动须另看。

projects.summary_zh: ReEvo：LLM 作为带反思进化的超启发式
projects.summary_en: ReEvo uses short-term and long-term language reflections to guide evolutionary search over combinatorial optimization heuristics. Candidate programs are revised within a problem-oriented implementation; the workbook treats reflective feedback as search guidance rather than neural parameter updates.
projects.mechanism_zh: 短期 / 长期反思指导进化搜索
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程（reevo.py、problems）
projects.caveat_zh: 反思改善候选搜索，不自动证明反思器自身变强；组合优化任务成绩不能泛化成普遍 RSI。

projects.summary_zh: 基于“智能体超网”的多智能体架构搜索
projects.summary_en: MaAS searches multiagent architectures through an agentic supernet, optimizing a distribution over structures and sampling task-specific subnetworks. The workbook describes architecture-level adaptation implemented as a package with examples, rather than direct self-editing of a model's source.
projects.mechanism_zh: 优化智能体架构的概率分布（agentic supernet），按查询动态采样子网络
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 maas + 示例
projects.caveat_zh: 优化架构分布不等于编辑搜索器自身，也不等于基座 LLM 权重训练；原行许可证未声明。

projects.summary_zh: 基于 Claude Code 的全自主 AI 科研系统，含自进化研究流水线
projects.summary_en: Sibyl System builds a research workflow around Claude Code, coordinating agents and GPU experiment execution with an evolution-oriented pipeline. The workbook describes plugin and web components, while its autonomous branding does not clarify which research procedures are themselves persistently optimized.
projects.mechanism_zh: 多智能体科学发现 + GPU 实验执行 + 自进化
projects.implementation_zh: 完整工程（插件、WebUI）
projects.caveat_zh: 依赖 Claude Code 宿主；流水线自进化边界未展开，不能补写模型训练、独立运行或普遍全自主能力。

projects.summary_zh: Dynamic Cheatsheet：带自适应记忆的测试时学习
projects.summary_en: Dynamic Cheatsheet preserves strategies, snippets and problem-solving advice across queries, then reuses that evolving context during inference. The workbook describes code and benchmark runners for memory-based test-time adaptation, rather than parameter training despite the learning terminology.
projects.target_zh: 推理时持久“小抄”上下文
projects.mechanism_zh: 跨查询存储并复用策略、代码片段与解题技巧
projects.implementation_zh: Python 代码 + 基准运行脚本
projects.caveat_zh: 测试时学习在这里依靠持久小抄；内容增多不一定变准，不能写成测试时 RL 权重更新。

projects.summary_zh: 评估 AI 智能体自动科研：从再发现到新发现
projects.summary_en: ResearchClawBench evaluates agents that turn raw data into research reports and compares their outputs with human research. The workbook describes tasks and workspaces for rediscovery and discovery-oriented assessment, but does not make the benchmark itself a self-improving research system.
projects.mechanism_zh: 从原始数据到报告，并与人类论文对比评估
projects.implementation_zh: 评测框架 + 任务 + 工作区
projects.caveat_zh: 从再发现到新发现是评测范围；对比人类论文不自动证明科学新颖性，技术栈原行未识别。

projects.summary_zh: 进化式多智能体运行时：繁殖、评估并改进自主智能体
projects.summary_en: KADATH treats prompts, Python implementations, tools and dependencies as an agent genome. A population competes under separate scoring, with mutation, reproduction and elimination selecting successors; the workbook describes a packaged runtime and container deployment.
projects.target_zh: 完整 Agent 基因组（系统提示、Python 实现、工具、依赖）
projects.mechanism_zh: 种群竞争 → 独立评分 → 变异 / 繁殖 / 淘汰的达尔文式进化
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + Docker 部署
projects.caveat_zh: 这里的“基因组”是软件配置与实现的比喻，不是生物基因组模型；种群选择不保证无奖励利用或通用能力增长。

projects.summary_zh: EvoPrompt：LLM + 进化算法的离散提示词优化
projects.summary_en: EvoPrompt searches discrete prompt candidates using language models to perform mutation and crossover within genetic or differential-evolution procedures. The workbook describes scripts for prompt optimization, keeping changes in the text space rather than claiming neural-weight or self-optimizer evolution.
projects.mechanism_zh: LLM 实现遗传算法 / 差分进化的变异与交叉
projects.implementation_zh: Python 脚本
projects.caveat_zh: 进化的是提示词；遗传／差分进化外层并不必自改写，也不代表神经权重训练。

projects.summary_zh: 基于执行轨迹的自动 harness 优化，追求可泛化的持久更新
projects.summary_en: AutoSaddler diagnoses agent execution traces and proposes structured updates to prompts, tools and middleware. Candidate changes are selected for persistent, transferable harness improvements; the workbook lists configurations and tests and attributes benchmark improvements to the source material.
projects.mechanism_zh: 诊断执行轨迹 → 结构化更新 → 选择可泛化改动（GAIA2 / SWE-Bench Pro / Terminal-Bench 2.0 提升约 9–10pp）
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 src/autosaddler（uv）+ 配置与测试
projects.caveat_zh: 目标是持久、可泛化更新，不表示泛化已由本次证明；来源中的多基准提升不能改写成独立复现结论。

projects.summary_zh: ExpeL：作为经验学习者的 LLM 智能体
projects.summary_en: ExpeL collects execution experience, extracts reusable insights and retrieves them during later inference. The workbook describes separate experience, insight-extraction and evaluation code, making a retained knowledge loop the mechanism rather than assuming its training-named entry point updates neural weights.
projects.mechanism_zh: 收集经验 → 提取洞见 → 推理时检索使用
projects.implementation_zh: Python 代码（train / eval / insight_extraction）
projects.caveat_zh: 文件入口叫 train 不足以证明权重训练；该行机制是经验池、洞见与检索，不应误写成参数更新。

projects.summary_zh: 哥德尔智能体：递归自我改进的自指智能体框架
projects.summary_en: Godel Agent exposes an agent's runtime logic and strategies for self-inspection and modification, including the strategy used to make improvements. The workbook lists source, datasets and results, distinguishing this self-referential scope from ordinary prompt-only optimization.
projects.target_zh: 智能体自身逻辑与代码（运行时）
projects.mechanism_zh: 在运行时读取并修改自身代码与策略（含改进策略本身）
projects.implementation_zh: Python 源码 + 数据集与结果
projects.caveat_zh: 自指修改是来源描述，不等于哥德尔机式最优性证明；有效性仍受具体任务与评估约束。

projects.summary_zh: 在模块化设计空间中自动搜索 LLM 智能体
projects.summary_en: AgentSquare explores modular agent designs by evolving and recombining planning, reasoning, tool and memory components. A performance predictor accelerates the search, while explicit implementation directories separate these operations; the workbook presents architecture search rather than unrestricted self-modification.
projects.target_zh: 智能体模块组合（规划 / 推理 / 工具 / 记忆）
projects.mechanism_zh: 模块进化 + 模块重组，配合性能预测器加速搜索
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程（module_evolution、module_recombination、search）
projects.caveat_zh: 性能预测器辅助搜索不替代最终评估；模块组合变化不证明搜索机制递归变强，许可证为未声明。

projects.summary_zh: SPIRAL：零和游戏自博弈激励推理能力
projects.summary_en: SPIRAL trains reasoning policies through multiagent, multiround reinforcement learning in zero-sum games. The workbook identifies training and evaluation code; game-based self-play supplies learning signals but does not by itself establish general reasoning transfer or an evolving outer optimizer.
projects.mechanism_zh: 多智能体、多轮 RL，在零和游戏中自博弈
projects.implementation_zh: 完整训练代码 + 评估
projects.caveat_zh: 零和游戏自博弈的迁移范围需要实测；工作簿未给最近提交，应保留活跃度未知。

projects.summary_zh: 跨智能体基准评测 RSI 方法的轻量 SDK / CLI
projects.summary_en: RSI Eval supplies a lightweight SDK and command-line interface connecting candidate generation, evaluation and feedback across agent benchmarks. The workbook describes a common integration contract, not a built-in guarantee that evaluation is calibrated or that submitted methods are recursively self-improving.
projects.mechanism_zh: 统一 candidate → evaluate → feedback 接口
projects.implementation_zh: Python SDK + CLI
projects.caveat_zh: 统一接口不保证任务可比或反馈正确；许可证需看文件，活跃度未知，不能自行补全。

projects.summary_zh: “参数是智能体的梯度下降”：并行异步的自进化智能体框架
projects.summary_en: Agentdescent runs parallel workers that propose changes to skills, prompts and harness artifacts. An asynchronous aggregator resolves conflicts, combines proposals and applies statistical acceptance, offering a concurrent optimization loop rather than literal gradients over neural model weights.
projects.mechanism_zh: N 个 worker 并行提出 diff，无屏障聚合器做冲突解决、融合与统计接受
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + bench + 集成 + 文档站
projects.caveat_zh: “梯度下降”是类比；并行 diff 聚合仍需评估与冲突处理，不能解读为神经权重更新或持续必然收益。

projects.summary_zh: RSI-Exam：在长程可执行研究任务上度量递归自我改进
projects.summary_en: RSI Exam evaluates long-running executable research tasks in a sandbox, asking agents to improve weak methods under hidden-data assessment. The workbook describes evaluation infrastructure; stronger submitted methods remain distinct from evidence that the agent's own improvement procedure evolves.
projects.mechanism_zh: 在 harbor 沙箱中要求智能体把弱方法改进为在隐藏数据上更好的方法
projects.implementation_zh: 评测基础设施
projects.caveat_zh: 隐藏数据提高评测约束，但方法变好不必意味着改进器自身变好；长程任务得分仍受预算与协议限定。

projects.summary_zh: Vision-SR1：通过推理分解实现自奖励的视觉语言模型
projects.summary_en: Vision-SR1 separates visual perception from language reasoning and uses a model's assessment of its own perception to supply rewards for training. The workbook describes a veRL-based implementation and data, targeting vision-language model weights rather than harness-only revision.
projects.mechanism_zh: 将推理拆分为视觉感知与语言推理，模型对自身感知给奖励
projects.implementation_zh: 基于 veRL 的训练代码 + 数据
projects.caveat_zh: 自奖励针对感知部分，不能等同外部真值检查；权重训练效果与视觉推理可靠性仍需独立验证。

projects.summary_zh: 开放问题上的测试时学习：简化并扩展 AlphaEvolve，同时扩展上下文学习与测试时 RL
projects.summary_en: ThetaEvolve combines a single-model program-evolution loop with reinforcement learning at test time on open optimization problems. Unlike purely frozen-model program search, the workbook lists both program solutions and changing model weights, with an upstream training-system dependency.
projects.target_zh: 程序解 + 模型权重（测试时 RL）
projects.mechanism_zh: 单 LLM 进化 + 测试时强化学习，8B 模型在开放优化问题上超越 AlphaEvolve
projects.implementation_zh: 基于 slime 的 Python 工程 + Docker
projects.caveat_zh: 该行明确结合测试时 RL 更新权重，不能只标冻结模型的程序搜索；“超越 AlphaEvolve”是来源报告而非本次比较。

projects.summary_zh: RE-Bench：对比人类专家评估前沿 AI 研发能力（官方已标注弃用）
projects.summary_en: RE Bench supplies AI research-and-development task environments for comparisons between agents and human experts. The workbook explicitly records deprecation alongside recent activity, so it should be presented as evaluation infrastructure with a maintenance caveat rather than an active endorsement or RSI implementation.
projects.mechanism_zh: 7 个 AI R&D 任务环境
projects.implementation_zh: 任务代码（METR Task Standard）
projects.caveat_zh: 来源已标弃用，即使近期提交仍“活跃”也不能删去弃用说明；人机研发能力比较不等于递归能力证明。

projects.summary_zh: 复杂真实环境中稳定、高效、可复用的机器人自进化 harness
projects.summary_en: RoboRSI organizes manager, planner, engineer and reviewer agents around a task-skill tree, refining skills from the top down. The workbook describes robot-oriented harness code and interfaces, with reusable skill structure as the improvement object rather than explicit neural-weight training.
projects.mechanism_zh: Manager / Planner / Engineer / Reviewer 多智能体 + 自上而下技能精炼（TSR）
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程 + CLI + Web 控制台
projects.caveat_zh: “稳定、高效、可复用”是来源定位；任务–技能树精炼不保证真实机器人部署安全或基座模型训练。

projects.summary_zh: 面向“自我迭代软件”的插件运行时：Agent 编写、替换并热加载自身插件
projects.summary_en: Rutis supplies a plugin runtime in which an agent can write replacement capabilities and hot-load them across processes. A Rust core manages lifecycle concerns for several plugin languages; the workbook chiefly establishes infrastructure for mutability, not measured self-improvement.
projects.target_zh: 运行中程序的插件与能力
projects.mechanism_zh: Rust 内核保障插件生命周期安全，支持 TS / Python / Go / Swift 插件跨进程热替换
projects.implementation_zh: 多语言工程（Rust crates + 多语言 SDK + fuzz）
projects.caveat_zh: 插件生命周期控制不证明每次替换都更优或全面安全；该行更像自迭代基础设施，而非已测得的递归优化结果。

projects.summary_zh: SkillWeaver：网页智能体通过发现与打磨技能自我改进
projects.summary_en: SkillWeaver explores websites, practices interactions and distills successful behavior into reusable skill APIs. The workbook describes a Python implementation whose adaptation grows an executable interface library, distinct from evidence that the browser agent's base model or improver is retrained.
projects.mechanism_zh: 自主探索网站 → 练习 → 蒸馏为可复用 API
projects.implementation_zh: Python 代码
projects.attribution_zh: 俄亥俄州立大学 OSU NLP
projects.caveat_zh: 可复用 API 需要适用性与验证；网站探索中的技能增长不等于模型权重学习或普遍递归能力。

projects.summary_zh: CodeEvolve：用于算法发现与优化的开源进化编码智能体
projects.summary_en: CodeEvolve combines language-model proposals with genetic search to optimize algorithm implementations. Its workbook entry describes a packaged core and problem collection, with candidate-code evolution as the central mechanism and no stated requirement that the outer search logic changes.
projects.mechanism_zh: LLM + 遗传算法进化搜索
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 src/codeevolve + problems
projects.caveat_zh: 目标是算法代码；遗传算法外层和 LLM 提议者是否改变没有来源证据，不能推断元递归。

projects.summary_zh: DeepEvolve：结合深度研究与 AlphaEvolve 的科学算法发现智能体
projects.summary_en: DeepEvolve combines research-oriented planning and retrieval with evolutionary edits to multifile scientific codebases. Automatic debugging supports candidate evaluation; the workbook describes an implementation and examples, but does not establish independent scientific novelty or a self-improving research policy.
projects.mechanism_zh: Deep Research 规划/检索新想法 + AlphaEvolve 式代码进化与自动调试
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程（deepevolve.py、examples）
projects.caveat_zh: 多文件搜索与研究检索不是科学新颖性保证，也不证明外层策略自改写；原行许可证未声明。

projects.summary_zh: DiscoveryRSI：递归学习发现有价值的研究假设（开放 27B 假设模型）
projects.summary_en: DiscoveryRSI develops research-hypothesis generation through a loop of evidence, criticism and revision. The workbook describes a hypothesis model alongside package, plugin and example components, but leaves the exact model-update procedure and evaluation conditions insufficiently detailed.
projects.mechanism_zh: 研究循环中从证据、批评与修订中学习
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + 插件 + 示例
projects.caveat_zh: 假设生成模型的“学习”没有明确训练细节；不得自行补写 RL、权重更新或性能，许可证与活跃度仍待来源文件。

projects.summary_zh: 群体进化智能体（GEA）：以智能体群为进化单元的开放式自我改进
projects.summary_en: GEA extends a DGM-style coding-agent evolution loop with explicit experience sharing within groups. Group-level reuse informs candidate code changes and evaluation on software tasks, making collective evolutionary search the mechanism described in the workbook.
projects.mechanism_zh: 在 DGM 式框架上引入群体内显式经验共享与复用
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程（GEA_outer.py、Docker、SWE-bench / Polyglot）
projects.caveat_zh: 群体共享经验是方法差异，不应宣称群体必然优于个体；基于 DGM 的外层循环是否自改写未由该行说明。

projects.summary_zh: Evolve：AI 智能体的在岗学习
projects.summary_en: ALTK Evolve transforms historical execution traces into reusable guidance, using vector memory and language-model conflict resolution behind a tool-server interface. The workbook describes package and plugin integrations for on-the-job adaptation, without requiring neural-model updates or unrestricted self-editing.
projects.mechanism_zh: 把历史轨迹转为指南；MCP 服务器 + 向量记忆 + LLM 冲突消解
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + 插件 + 平台集成
projects.caveat_zh: 向量记忆和冲突消解帮助组织指南，不保证指南正确；“在岗学习”不是神经权重训练的充分证据。

projects.summary_zh: 受控自进化（CSE）：面向算法代码效率优化的自进化框架
projects.summary_en: EvoControl searches for more efficient algorithm implementations using diverse initial plans, genetic evolution and hierarchical experience memory. The workbook identifies performance-oriented code directories, with runtime and space efficiency as targets rather than autonomous improvement of the model itself.
projects.target_zh: 算法代码（时间/空间复杂度）
projects.mechanism_zh: 多样化规划初始化 + 遗传进化 + 层次化经验记忆
projects.implementation_zh: Python 工程（SE_Perf、perfagent）
projects.caveat_zh: 时间／空间效率优化仍需正确性与公平预算；“受控”不表示全部风险被解决，改进对象是算法代码。

projects.summary_zh: 递归自我改进的研究循环，构建 Jev 式决策模型（AutoScientists 下一版）
projects.summary_en: RSI Jev organizes research around proposed hypotheses, preregistered predictions and experiments that challenge a current champion decision model. The workbook describes training and evaluation artifacts, making evidence-driven model replacement the stated loop rather than unrestricted autonomous scientific validity.
projects.mechanism_zh: 智能体提出假设、预注册预测、运行实验、依证据淘汰冠军模型
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + notebooks + 站点
projects.caveat_zh: 预注册预测与淘汰冠军是研究规则，不保证结论正确；“AutoScientists 下一版”是关联描述，不应合并两个仓库。

projects.summary_zh: EvolveR：经验驱动生命周期的自进化 LLM 智能体
projects.summary_en: EvolveR distills abstract principles from execution trajectories, retrieves them for later decisions and combines this experience loop with reinforcement-learning policy updates. The workbook describes memory and training components together, making it a mixed weight-and-experience approach.
projects.target_zh: 策略权重 + 经验原则库
projects.mechanism_zh: 从轨迹蒸馏抽象原则并检索复用，结合 RL 更新策略
projects.implementation_zh: Python 实现（含 veRL、LLaMA-Factory）
projects.caveat_zh: 它同时使用原则库与 RL 更新策略，不能简化为免训练记忆方法；活跃度原行未知。

projects.summary_zh: GigaEvo：用 LLM 自动改进程序的进化算法框架
projects.summary_en: GigaEvo evolves Python programs using quality-diversity archives and multiple islands, while also allowing prompt co-evolution. The workbook describes packaged search code, notebooks and problems; these coupled textual and program candidates are distinct from changing neural model weights.
projects.mechanism_zh: MAP-Elites、多岛进化与提示词协同进化
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + notebooks + 问题集
projects.caveat_zh: 提示与程序共同进化不等于神经权重训练，也不自动说明外层进化机制会改写自身。

projects.summary_zh: 面向机器人操作的递归自我改进（真实机器人实验）
projects.summary_en: Recursia improves a shared executable Python skill stack from source-task feedback, then freezes that stack for recombination on new robot tasks. The workbook describes physical-robot and simulation code, separating the adaptation phase from later transfer using unchanged skills.
projects.target_zh: 共享可执行 Python 技能栈
projects.mechanism_zh: 基于源任务反馈改进程序，冻结后复用于新任务组合
projects.implementation_zh: Python 代码（Franka FR3 实验 + 仿真）
projects.caveat_zh: 新任务阶段冻结技能栈，不能写成在那里仍持续递归改进；真实机器人实验是工作簿报告而非本次复现。

projects.summary_zh: SiriuS：通过自举推理实现自我改进的多智能体系统
projects.summary_en: SiriuS retains successful trajectories, repairs unsuccessful attempts through bootstrapping and uses the resulting experience for role-specific multiagent fine-tuning. The workbook describes several interaction settings; persistent experience supports training rather than substituting entirely for parameter updates.
projects.target_zh: 多智能体各角色模型权重
projects.mechanism_zh: 维护成功轨迹经验库并从失败中自举修正，用于微调
projects.implementation_zh: Python 代码（问题求解 / Actor-Critic / 竞争三种设置）
projects.caveat_zh: 经验库最终用于各角色微调，不只是推理时检索；成功轨迹和自修正仍需可靠的筛选标准。

projects.summary_zh: RSI Bench：评估 AI 智能体推进 AI 研发所需能力
projects.summary_en: RSI Benchmark packages AI research-and-development tasks, checks and tools, including post-training method-improvement exercises. The workbook describes infrastructure for assessing submitted agents; improving a task solution does not by itself establish that an agent recursively changes its own optimizer.
projects.target_zh: 评测：RSI / AI 研发能力
projects.mechanism_zh: 后训练等类别任务（如改进 on-policy 自蒸馏方法）
projects.implementation_zh: 任务 + 检查脚本 + 工具
projects.caveat_zh: 名称含 RSI 仍需看实际任务；后训练方法改进不自动证明元递归，基准与被测系统应分开。

projects.summary_zh: 与 harness 无关的模块化智能体自我改进框架
projects.summary_en: Proteus separates optimization methods, runtime adapters and evaluation protocols so different improvement recipes can target prompts, memory, skills or harness code. The workbook describes configurable composition and visualization, without making one recursively self-editing optimizer mandatory.
projects.target_zh: 提示词、记忆、技能或 harness 源码
projects.mechanism_zh: 优化方法、运行时与评估协议独立可配置，支持组合式方法与进化过程可视化
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + recipes / environments / Web 可视化
projects.caveat_zh: “与 Harness 无关”应理解为不绑定特定宿主，而非不修改 Harness；可组合方法不必然具备元递归。

projects.summary_zh: 搜索自博弈 SSP：无监督提升搜索智能体能力
projects.summary_en: SSP pits a question-generating proposer against a solver, allowing both to use search over multiple rounds. Their interaction drives reinforcement-learning updates to agent weights; the workbook describes integration with existing training and search-agent implementations.
projects.mechanism_zh: Proposer 生成难题、Solver 求解，双方均可多轮调用搜索引擎的对抗自博弈 RL
projects.implementation_zh: 基于 veRL 与 Search-R1 的实现
projects.attribution_zh: 阿里巴巴夸克 LLM 团队
projects.caveat_zh: “无监督”不代表没有搜索引擎、预训练和奖励规则；提议者／求解者自博弈仍受这些外部条件约束。

projects.summary_zh: 自进化智能体的“误进化”风险
projects.summary_en: Misevolution studies safety degradation across changes to models, memory, tools and workflows, with experiments covering several failure routes. The workbook describes experiment directories rather than a safeguard deployment, making it a risk-analysis implementation rather than a proven self-improvement system.
projects.target_zh: 研究对象：模型 / 记忆 / 工具 / 工作流进化中的安全退化
projects.mechanism_zh: 四类误进化路径的实验与评测
projects.implementation_zh: 四个实验目录代码
projects.caveat_zh: 研究误进化风险不等于提供可部署防护，也不说明自身在改进；许可证未声明，技术栈未识别。

projects.summary_zh: (Self-Improving)² 编码智能体：经递归自我改进策划高质量训练轨迹
projects.summary_en: SI2CA curates coding-agent training trajectories using action-level self-judgment and likelihood signals, while a recursive improvement framework optimizes branching timing to reduce cost. The workbook includes curation, evaluation and training, separating data-selection decisions from subsequent model-weight updates.
projects.target_zh: 编码智能体模型（训练数据）
projects.mechanism_zh: 回合级 Self-Judgement / Self-Likelihood 选动作，RSI 框架优化分支时机以降低成本
projects.implementation_zh: 完整工程（轨迹策划、评估、训练）
projects.caveat_zh: 主要桥梁是轨迹策划与训练；分支时机优化不应直接写成基座模型在运行时自改写。

projects.summary_zh: CoEvoSkills：通过协同进化验证实现自进化智能体技能
projects.summary_en: CoEvoSkills co-evolves multifile skill packages and their validators without requiring supplied answer keys. The workbook describes task code for this coupled process; the crucial distinction is jointly changing skills and evaluation machinery rather than independently verified improvement.
projects.mechanism_zh: 无需真值答案，技能与验证器协同进化
projects.implementation_zh: Python 代码 + 任务
projects.caveat_zh: 技能与验证器共同变化有共谋、自评分漂移风险；无需真值不表示无需外部校准，也不证明收益真实。

projects.summary_zh: FunSearch 高性能社区实现：以 LLM 为变异算子的遗传编程
projects.summary_en: This community FunSearch implementation uses language-model mutations and island-based genetic programming to search mathematical or optimization functions. The workbook notes flexible function signatures, parallel execution and deployment examples, distinguishing it from the excluded official results-and-skeleton repository.
projects.target_zh: 数学构造 / 优化程序
projects.mechanism_zh: LLM 变异 + 岛模型进化，支持任意函数签名与并行
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + Docker + 示例
projects.caveat_zh: 这是 kitft 社区实现，不能与被排除的官方 FunSearch 仓库混同；搜索产物提高不等于优化器递归提高。

projects.summary_zh: AgentFactory：通过可执行子智能体积累与复用实现自进化
projects.summary_en: AgentFactory preserves successful solutions as executable subagents and refines their code from later execution feedback. The workbook describes a code library and web interface, with accumulation and reuse of capabilities distinct from mandatory self-editing of the core agent loop.
projects.target_zh: 可执行子智能体代码库
projects.mechanism_zh: 把成功方案保存为子智能体代码，并依据执行反馈持续精炼
projects.implementation_zh: Python 代码 + Web 界面
projects.caveat_zh: 保留子智能体代码不等于核心 Agent 自改写；持续精炼需要可靠执行反馈与适用范围。

projects.summary_zh: DREAM-RSI 官方代码：通过“演化世界”递归改进探索策略
projects.summary_en: DREAM-RSI records online exploration as discovery trees and replayable worlds, then rewrites exploration-policy code offline and evaluates it against those replays. The workbook thus targets how a coding agent allocates discovery effort, not merely its current solution.
projects.target_zh: 探索策略（编码 Agent 如何分配发现预算）
projects.mechanism_zh: 在线 rollout 形成发现树并存为回放世界 → 离线“做梦”重写策略代码并在回放世界上评估
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 dream_rsi + 任务与脚本（含 KernelBench）
projects.caveat_zh: 这里修改探索策略，较普通解搜索更接近改进搜索机制；回放世界上的收益仍不保证新任务迁移。

projects.summary_zh: 自提问语言模型 SQLM：非对称自博弈
projects.summary_en: Self-Questioning LM trains an asymmetric proposer-solver interaction in which topic-conditioned questions become challenges for a responding model. The workbook describes a veRL-based implementation, with model-weight updates as the retained change rather than a dynamically edited agent runtime.
projects.mechanism_zh: Proposer 按主题出题，Solver 作答，基于 veRL 训练
projects.implementation_zh: 基于 veRL 的实现
projects.caveat_zh: 主题约束、奖励与训练框架仍是条件；非对称自博弈不自动证明提问策略或优化器持续变优。

projects.summary_zh: 测试时课程合成 TTCS：Synthesizer–Solver 协同自进化
projects.summary_en: TTCS synthesizes a curriculum at test time and co-adapts a synthesizer and solver for mathematical reasoning. The workbook describes training-system-dependent code and evaluation; this is a parameter-learning approach, not merely replaying solved examples in an unchanged context.
projects.mechanism_zh: 测试时动态合成课程，合成器与求解器共同进化
projects.implementation_zh: 基于 veRL 的代码 + 评估
projects.caveat_zh: 测试时课程合成与双模型训练要区分；数学任务效果不是普遍迁移证明，许可证为未声明。

projects.summary_zh: 自学优化器 STOP：递归自我改进的代码生成
projects.summary_en: STOP studies an improvement program that can be applied to its own scaffold code, including the improver itself. The workbook describes scripts for running and evaluating these recursive code-generation experiments, rather than model-weight training or formal optimality verification.
projects.target_zh: 脚手架程序（含改进器自身）
projects.mechanism_zh: 用改进器改进自身代码（self-improver improves itself）
projects.implementation_zh: Python 脚本（run_improver、eval_improver、tasks）
projects.caveat_zh: 改进器自身是可修改对象，但脚本级实验不能扩展成无限递归保证；来源较旧的相对提交时间仍仅是快照。

projects.summary_zh: EvoLib：基于演化知识库的测试时学习
projects.summary_en: EvoLib extracts reusable knowledge abstractions from reasoning trajectories, retrieves them across tasks and updates a shared library. The workbook explicitly states that this test-time learning uses no parameter updates, distinguishing asset evolution from training a stronger base language model.
projects.mechanism_zh: 从自身推理轨迹提取、复用并演化知识抽象，无参数更新
projects.implementation_zh: Python 代码（AgentBoard）
projects.caveat_zh: 该行明确无参数更新；演化知识抽象是记忆资产，不可改写成测试时权重训练。

projects.summary_zh: 与基准无关的 LLM Agent harness 自动优化框架（AHO）
projects.summary_en: Agent Harness Optimizer runs a benchmark-facing inner agent while an outer proposer examines failures and writes targeted prompt or tool-middleware fixes. The workbook describes packaged implementation and reproducibility configurations, with benchmark independence referring to framework integration.
projects.target_zh: 系统提示与工具调用中间件
projects.mechanism_zh: 内层模型跑基准，外层 Proposer 读取失败案例并写入定向修复
projects.implementation_zh: Python 包 + 论文复现配置（BFCL）
projects.caveat_zh: 外层 Proposer 优化内层 Harness，不等于 Proposer 自身递归变化；来源类别采用企业官方实现的 Star 门槛例外。

projects.summary_zh: Ratchet：自进化 LLM 智能体的最小“卫生”配方
projects.summary_en: Ratchet clusters failures into candidate natural-language skills, inserts useful skills into prompts and retires them when they stop helping. The workbook describes a minimal reference implementation for managing skill-library drift, not a comprehensive safety proof or neural-weight training procedure.
projects.target_zh: 受治理的自然语言技能库
projects.mechanism_zh: 从聚类失败合成技能、注入提示、失效即退役，限制技能库漂移
projects.implementation_zh: Python 参考实现
projects.caveat_zh: 失败聚类、技能注入及退役属于有限卫生治理；不能保证无漂移、无奖励利用或普遍安全。

projects.summary_zh: AlphaEvolve 官方仓库：最小实现 + 数学发现与矩阵乘法成果
projects.summary_en: The workbook describes an official AlphaEvolve repository with a minimal source implementation and local evaluation, alongside mathematical and matrix-multiplication result artifacts. This limited release should not be equated with the full distributed discovery system or community implementations.
projects.target_zh: 算法 / 数学构造程序
projects.mechanism_zh: LLM 进化式编码（/src 为带本地评估的最小实现）
projects.implementation_zh: /src 最小实现；其余为成果验证 Colab 与数据（新发布，Star 可能滞后）
projects.reference_zh: 论文链接待补（README 标注 TODO）
projects.caveat_zh: 仅按来源标为 /src 最小实现，其余多为成果验证；论文链接 TODO、许可证需见文件、活跃度未知，不能补造完整引擎。
